original: na ca tatvanirṇayamātraphalakavādakathāyāṃ vipratipatteranāvaśyakatvaṃ pratyakṣālokādigranthasammatyā naiyāyikādisiddhameva| jalpe tu svasvavijayārthameva vicāre pravṛttisambhavena phalāntarānusandhānaṃ nāpekṣitamiti vācyam| evamapi sabhyasabhāpatyādīnāṃ svakīyaphalānusandhānaṃ vinā tatra manaḥpraṇidhānāyogenoktarītyā vipratipattestadarthakatvāt|
analyzed: na ca tatva nirṇaya mātra phalaka vāda kathāyām vipratipatteḥ anāvaśyaka tvam pratyakṣa āloka ādi grantha sammatyā naiyāyika ādi siddham eva jalpe tu sva sva vijaya artham eva vicāre pravṛtti sambhavena phala antara anusandhānam na apekṣitam iti vācyam evam api sabhya sabhāpati ādīnām svakīya phala anusandhānam vinā tatra manaḥ praṇidhāna ayogena ukta rītyā vipratipatteḥ tad arthaka tvāt

original: na ca pūrvoktarītyā kutrāpi phalānupadhāne svarūpayogyatā'pi nāsti| kalpakābhāvāditi vācyam| sabhyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidvattvaniyamābhāvātsabhābahirbhāveṇa kadācittajjātīyavākyena saṃśayasyānyeṣāṃ sambhavena ca phalānupadhānāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: na ca pūrva ukta rītyā kutra api phala anupadhāne svarūpa yogyatā api nā asti kalpaka abhāvāt iti vācyam sabhyānām sarveṣām vidvat tva niyama abhāvāt sabhā bahirbhāveṇa kadācid tad jātīya vākyena saṃśayasya anyeṣām sambhavena ca phala anupadhāna asiddheḥ

original: na caivamajñānaviparyayanivṛttirūpaphalapratiyogyajñānādijanakavākyamapyāvaśyakaṃ syāditi vācyam| ajñānasyānāditayā tajjanakavākyāsiddheḥ| saṃśayanivṛtterajñānanivṛttimūlakatvena pṛthagyatnānapekṣaṇācca| sarveṣāmekadarśananiviṣṭatvaniyamābhāvena sarvanirasanīyaikakoṭerabhāvena idamitthamevetyākārakasya viparyayavākyasya darśayitumaśakyatvāt|
analyzed: na ca evam ajñāna viparyaya nivṛtti rūpa phala pratiyogi ajñāna ādi janaka vākyam api āvaśyakam syāt iti vācyam ajñānasya anādi tayā tad janaka vākya asiddheḥ saṃśaya nivṛtteḥ ajñāna nivṛtti mūlaka tvena pṛthak yatna anapekṣaṇāt ca sarveṣām eka darśana niviṣṭa tva niyama abhāvena sarva nirasanīya eka koṭeḥ abhāvena idam ittham eva iti ākārakasya viparyaya vākyasya darśayitum aśakya tvāt

original: kiñca vipratipatternaitāvanmātraṃ prayojanam| anyadapi vartate| vipratipattivākye prayukte sarvaiḥ koṭidvayasya śrutatvāttadapalāpapūrvakaṃ vādinoranyatareṇa viṣayāntaragrahaṇapūrvakaṃ svajayaḥ sthāpayituṃ naiva śakyate| anyathā jayaparājayavyavasthā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: kiñca vipratipatteḥ na etāvat mātram prayojanam anyat api vartate vipratipatti vākye prayukte sarvaiḥ koṭi dvayasya śruta tvāt tad apalāpa pūrvakam vādinoḥ anyatareṇa viṣaya antara grahaṇa pūrvakam sva jayaḥ sthāpayitum nā eva śakyate anyathā jaya parājaya vyavasthā bhāva prasaṅgāt

original: evaṃ madhyasthena svayamevaikaikaṃ pratyekaikapakṣadāne tatsamarthanāśaktena vādinā anyatarasminpakṣapātaḥ svasminnasūyādikaṃ vyavahriyeta|
analyzed: evam madhyasthena svayam eva ekaikam pratyeka eka pakṣa dāne tad samarthana aśaktena vādinā anyatarasmin pakṣapātaḥ svasmin asūyā ādikam vyavahriyeta

original: ato vipratipattivākyenobhābhyāṃ koṭiśravaṇānantaraṃ svayameva pakṣaviśeṣagrahaṇe pakṣāntarasamarthanāśaktatvaśaṅkā lokānāṃ syādityabhiprāyavadbhyāṃ vādibhyāṃ tvayaiva kaścana pakṣo deya ityuktyanantarameva tathākaraṇe svasya doṣābhāvāt| ata etadubhayaprayojanārthamapi vipratipattirāvaśyikī| etena sādhāraṇadharmādipratibandidānaṃ parāstam|
analyzed: atas vipratipatti vākyena ubhābhyām koṭi śravaṇa anantaram svayam eva pakṣa viśeṣa grahaṇe pakṣa antara samarthana aśaktatva śaṅkā lokānām syāt iti abhiprāyavadbhyām vādibhyām tvayā eva kaścana pakṣaḥ deyaḥ iti ukti anantaram eva tathā karaṇe svasya doṣa abhāvāt atas etad ubhaya prayojana artham api vipratipattiḥ āvaśyikī etena sādhāraṇa dharma ādi pratibandi dānam parāstam

original: tasmātsvakartavyanirvāhāya samayavandhādivadvipratipattirdarśanīyaiva| paramavayaveṣu nāgraha'iti|
analyzed: tasmāt sva kartavya nirvāhāya samaya vandha ādi vat vipratipattiḥ darśanīyā eva param avayaveṣu na āgraha eti

original: tanna| `śabdo guṇatvena naiyāyikābhyupagamaviṣayo dravyatvena tu mīmāṃsakānām| ato yathākāmanyatarapakṣā'śrayaṇaṃ kāryam' ityākārakeṇa saṃskṛtena tatsamārthakabhāṣārūpavākyena vā madhyasthoktena pūrvoktasarvaprayojananirvāhāt ekasmindharmiṇi viruddhakoṭidvayaśābdadhījananayogyatvādinānākusṛṣṭyādiyuktavākyaviśeṣarūpavipratipatteranāvaśyakatāyā
analyzed: tat na śabdaḥ guṇa tvena naiyāyika abhyupagama viṣayaḥ dravya tvena tu mīmāṃsakānām atas yathākām anyatara pakṣa āśrayaṇam kāryam iti ākārakeṇa saṃskṛtena tad sama arthaka bhāṣā rūpa vākyena vā madhyastha uktena pūrvokta sarva prayojana nirvāhāt ekasmin dharmiṇi viruddha koṭi dvaya śābda dhī janana yogya tva ādi nānā kusṛṣṭi ādi yukta vākya viśeṣa rūpa vipratipatteḥ anāvaśyaka tāyāḥ

original: nyāyāmṛtoktāyā etādṛśaśatoktibhirapyaparihārāt| na hi nyāyāmṛte sarvathā'nupayoga uktaḥ| kintvanāvaśyakatvamātram| na hi kathāpūrvaṃ madhyasthādibhirbhāṣayā vyavahāre kiñcidbādhakam| pratyuta prākṛtādīnāmapi sujñānāya tasyaivocitatvañca|
analyzed: nyāyāmṛta uktāyāḥ etādṛśa śata uktibhiḥ api aparihārāt na hi nyāyāmṛte sarvathā anupayogaḥ uktaḥ kintu anāvaśyaka tva mātram na hi kathā pūrvam madhyastha ādibhiḥ bhāṣayā vyavahāre kiñcid bādhakam pratyuta prākṛta ādīnām api su jñānāya tasya eva ucita tvam ca

original: api ca sabhāpatipreritenānyenaivoktarītyā vādiprativādibhyāṃ pakṣaparigrahādikaṃ kārayitvā anantaraṃ madhyastho niyamitaḥ| tatra madhyasthasya vipratipattidarśanānavakāśācca| yatra sarvaviṣayeṣu tatkāle madhyasthakalpitavākyasyānyadāpyuccāraniyamābhāvātsaṃśayājananaṃ teṣu svarūpayogyatvakalpakābhāvācca|
analyzed: api ca sabhāpati preritena anyena evā ukta rītyā vādi prativādibhyām pakṣa parigraha ādikam kārayitvā anantaram madhyasthaḥ niyamitaḥ tatra madhyasthasya vipratipatti darśana anavakāśāt ca yatra sarva viṣayeṣu tad kāle madhyastha kalpita vākyasya anyadā api uccāra niyama abhāvāt saṃśaya ajananam teṣu sva rūpa yogya tva kalpaka abhāvāt ca

original: kvacittasya sattvepi jñānasyaiva svasyopayogena sarveṣāṃ tajjñānaniyamābhāvena sarveṣāṃ saṃśayasmārakatvāyogaśca| keṣāñcitsambhave'pi bhāvivicāratya saṃśayanivṛttinirvāhakatvānupasthityā tatra sabhāpatyādīnāṃ manaḥpraṇidhānasya tato'nirvāhācca|
analyzed: kvacid tasya sattve pi jñānasya eva svasya upayogena sarveṣām tad jñāna niyama abhāvena sarveṣām saṃśaya smāraka tva ayogaḥ ca keṣāñcid sambhave pi saṃśaya nivṛtti nirvāhaka tva anupasthityā tatra sabhāpati ādīnām manaḥ praṇidhānasya tatas nirvāhāt ca

original: yatra sabhāpatyādīnāmanyatarakoṭiniścaya eva tatra svakartavyasanmānopayogitadutkarṣajñānārthameva naḥpraṇidhānopapatteśca| vādinoḥ prāmāṇikatve niścite'sādhakatāsthalīyanyāye udāharaṇaprayogasyeva samayaviśeṣabandhasyāpyakartavyatayā dṛṣṭāntasya niyamena sārvatrikatayā'sammateśca|
analyzed: yatra sabhāpati ādīnām anyatara koṭi niścayaḥ eva tatra sva kartavya sanmāna upayogi tad utkarṣa jñāna artham eva naḥ praṇidhāna upapatteḥ ca vādinoḥ prāmāṇika tve niścitesādhakatā sthalīya nyāye udāharaṇa prayogasya iva samaya viśeṣa bandhasya api akartavya tayā dṛṣṭāntasya niyamena sārvatrika tayā asammateḥ ca

original: vākyaviśeṣasya kṣemasādhāraṇamajñānanirvāhakatvamapi bhavatīti phalasmaraṇopayogitāmātreṇa tatpradarśanapratibandyapi yuktaiva| tasamādavayaveṣviva vipratipattāvapyāvaśyakatvāgrahastyājya evetyataḥ|
analyzed: vākya viśeṣasya kṣema sādhāraṇam ajñāna nirvāhaka tvam api bhavati iti phala smaraṇa upayogi tā mātreṇa tad pradarśana pratibandī api yuktā eva ta samāt avayaveṣu iva vipratipattau api āvaśyaka tva āgrahaḥ tyājyaḥ eva iti atas

original: nanu kiñciddharmopahite tadupalakṣite vā caitanye sarvādhiṣṭhānabhūte bhedasyāpi sattvena na manmate pakṣatāvacchedakopahite tadupalakṣite vā bhedakoṭikavipratipattiḥ sambhavati|
analyzed: nanu kiñcid dharma upahite tad upalakṣite vā caitanye sarva adhiṣṭhāna bhūte bhedasya api sattvena na mad mate pakṣatā avacchedaka upahite tad upalakṣite vā bheda koṭika vipratipattiḥ sambhavati

original: na ca tvanmate ghaṭaścinnetyādipratītisiddhabhedasya ghaṭāvacchinnacityāropitatvena citi tādātmyasambandhena bhedasattve'pi ciccinneti pratītivāraṇāya `nañullekhyapratītau viśeṣaṇatāsambandho bhāsate| tena sambandhena tu citi sa bhedo nāsti' iti vaktavyam| evañca bhedāntarāṇāmapi tādātmyasattve'pi na viśeṣaṇatāsambandhena vṛttitvam|
analyzed: na ca tvad mate ghaṭaḥ cit nā ityādi pratīti siddha bhedasya ghaṭa avacchinna citi āropita tvena citi tādātmya sambandhena bheda sattve pi cit cit nā iti pratīti vāraṇāya nañ ullekhya pratītau viśeṣaṇa tā sambandhaḥ bhāsate tena sambandhena tu citi sa bhedaḥ na asti iti vaktavyam evam ca bheda antarāṇām api tādātmya sattve pi na viśeṣaṇa tā sambandhena vṛtti tvam

original: prakṛte ca muktatvopalakṣite tatsambandhasaṃsargakabhedakoṭikavipratipattiryuktā| ciddhaṭo neti pratītisiddhabhedo yadyapi śuddhaciti viśeṣaṇatāsambandhena vartata ityāpātataḥ pratibhāti tathāpi sa svopahita eva vartate| anyathā śuddhatvahāniprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: prakṛte ca mukta tva upalakṣite tad sambandha saṃsargaka bheda koṭika vipratipattiḥ yuktā cit dhaṭaḥ na iti pratīti siddha bhedaḥ yadi api śuddha citi viśeṣaṇatā sambandhena vartate iti āpātataḥ pratibhāti tathā api sa sva upahitaḥ eva vartate anyathā śuddha tva hāni prasaṅgāt

original: eṃva anyeṣāmapi bhedānāmiti śuddhaciti bhedasyāsiddhatayā muktatvopalakṣitāyāṃ citi bhedakoṭikavipratipattisambhavena tatra tatsādhane kathaṃ siddhasādhanatāvakāśa iti vācyam| anumitervā vipratipattighaṭakavākyasya vā yadi muktatvarūpadharmapuraskāreṇa viśeṣyāvagāhitā tadā muktatvopahitasyaivānumitau bhānānna śuddhaciti bhedasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: anyeṣām api bhedānām iti śuddha citi bhedasya asiddha tayā mukta tva upalakṣitāyām citi bheda koṭika vipratipatti sambhavena tatra tad sādhane katham siddhasādhanatā avakāśaḥ iti vācyam anumiteḥ vā vipratipatti ghaṭaka vākyasya vā yadi mukta tva rūpa dharma puraskāreṇa viśeṣya avagāhitā tadā mukta tva upahitasya eva anumitau bhānāt na śuddha citi bheda siddhiḥ

original: vipratipattighaṭakavākyena ca tadupahitabhedasyāṅgīkṛtatvāttanniṣedharūpakoṭipratipādanānupapattiḥ| yadi copalakṣaṇībhūtadharmasya dharmāntaropalakṣakatvaṃ kvacicca svarūpopalakṣakatvañcāṅgīkṛtam| tasyāyaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ phalībhūtabodhe bhāsamānadharmāntaropasthāpakaḥ san phalībhūtavodhe svayamabhāsamānaḥ kvacidbhavati|
analyzed: vipratipatti ghaṭaka vākyena ca tad upahita bhedasya aṅgīkṛta tvāt tad niṣedha rūpa koṭi pratipādana anupapattiḥ yadi ca upalakṣaṇībhūta dharmasya dharma antara upalakṣaka tvam kvacid ca svarūpa upalakṣaka tvam ca aṅgīkṛtam tasya ayam niṣkarṣaḥ phalībhūta bodhe bhāsamāna dharma antara upasthāpakaḥ san phalībhūta vodhe svayam abhāsamānaḥ kvacid bhavati

original: kvacicca phalībhūtabodhe bhāsamānasvarūpamātropasthāpakaḥ san tatra svayamabhāsamānaḥ svarūpopalakṣaṇamityucyate iti| etadudāharaṇādikantvākare vyaktam| evañcehāpi yadi muktatvaṃ dharmāntaramupasthāpya svayaṃ nivartate tadā vipratipattivākyena dharmāntaraviśeṣitaciti bhedaniṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt| sa cānupapannaḥ|
analyzed: kvacid ca phalībhūta bodhe bhāsamāna svarūpa mātra upasthāpakaḥ san tatra svayam abhāsamānaḥ sva rūpa upalakṣaṇam iti ucyate iti etat udāharaṇa ādikam tu ākare vyaktam evam ca iha api yadi mukta tvam dharma antaram upasthāpya svayam nivartate tadā vipratipatti vākyena dharma antara viśeṣita citi bheda niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt sa ca anupapannaḥ

original: muktatvopahita iva dharmāntaropahite'pi bhedāṅgīkārāt| evaṃ siddhārthā pratijñā syāt| dharmāntaropahite bhedasyābhyupagatatvāt| yadi ca svarūpamātrepalakṣaṇaṃ syāt tadā mukto na bhinna iti vākyaṃ vā nañ‌ghaṭitoktavākyaṃ vā svarūpamātrāvagāhinaṃ bhedābhāvavān ityākārakaṃ vā bhedavān ityākārakaṃ vā bodhaṃ janayet|
analyzed: mukta tva upahite iva dharma antara upahite api bheda aṅgīkārāt evam siddhārthā pratijñā syāt dharma antara upahite bhedasya abhyupagata tvāt yadi ca sva rūpa mātra ipalakṣaṇam syāt tadā muktaḥ na bhinnaḥ iti vākyam vā nañ ghaṭita ukta vākyam vā sva rūpa mātra avagāhinam bheda abhāvavān iti ākārakam vā bhedavān iti ākārakam vā bodham janayet

original: tathā ca kathaṃ tadvākyayorvipratipattivākyatvam| tadubhayajanyabodhasya tadadhīnabodhāntarasya vā saṃśayarūpatvābhāvena tajjanakatvābhāvāt| nirdharmitāvacchedakakasaṃśayābhāvāt| anumitirapi kathamaktavidhamuktatvopalakṣitacidavagāhinī syāt| tasyā nirdharmitāvarcchedakakatvādyabhāvāt|
analyzed: tathā ca katham tad vākyayoḥ vipratipatti vākyatvam tad ubhaya janya bodhasya tad adhīna bodha antarasya vā saṃśaya rūpa tva abhāvena tad janaka tva abhāvāt nirdharmi tā avacchedakaka saṃśaya abhāvāt anumitiḥ api katham aktavidha mukta tva upalakṣita cit avagāhinī syāt tasyāḥ nirdharmi tā āvarcchedakaka tva ādi abhāvāt

original: atha manyase `muktatvopalakṣite bhānaṃ nāma muktatvasāmānādhikaraṇyamātrasya prakārāṃśe bhānam| prakārasambandhe muktatvāvacchinnatvabhānantu tadupahite bhānam| prakṛte ca kiñcidupahitacityeva bhedasya bhavadaṅgīkṛtatvena muktatvenopalakṣitāyāṃ śuddhaciti bhedābhāvakoṭikā vipratipattiryuktā' iti| tadapyayuktam|
analyzed: atha manyase mukta tva upalakṣite bhānam nāma mukta tva sāmānādhikaraṇya mātrasya prakāra aṃśe bhānam prakāra sambandhe mukta tva avacchinna tva bhānam tu tad upahite bhānam prakṛte ca kiñcid upahita citi eva bhedasya bhavat aṅgīkṛta tvena mukta tvena upalakṣitāyām śuddha citi bheda abhāva koṭikā vipratipattiḥ yuktā iti tat api ayuktam

original: muktatvāśrayatvasya muktatvopahita eva sattvena tena rūpeṇa śuddhacitau vipratipattivākyena bhāsamānatvena tadupahitasyaiva bhānena tatra vipratipattyayogasyoktatvāt| yadi copahitadharmāṇāṃ śuddhavṛttitvasyābhyupagamānmuktatvaṃ śuddhaciti vartata iti bravīṣi tadā bhedo'pi tatra vartata eveti kathaṃ tatra tatkoṭikā vimatiḥ syāt|
analyzed: muktatva āśraya tvasya muktatva upahite eva sattvena tena rūpeṇa śuddha citau vipratipatti vākyena bhāsamāna tvena tad upahitasya eva bhānena tatra vipratipatti ayogasya ukta tvāt yadi ca upahita dharmāṇām śuddha vṛtti tvasya abhyupagamāt muktatvam śuddha citi vartate iti bravīṣi tadā tatra vartate eva iti katham tatra tad koṭikā vimatiḥ syāt

original: kiñca śuddhaciti kathamapi bhedo nāstītyabhyupetya muktatvopalakṣitāyāṃ bhedābhāvakoṭikā vipratipattiḥ muktatvopalakṣite bhedasādhane śuddhaciti bhedamātrasiddhyā ātmanaḥ kṛtārthateti yadi manuṣe tarhi ātmatvasaṃsāritvādidharmeṣu kasyacitpakṣatāvacchedakatvānusaraṇe vipratipatteściti bhedasiddhisambhavena siddhasādhanatādoṣeṇaiva
analyzed: kiñca śuddha citi katham api bhedaḥ na asti iti abhyupetya mukta tva upalakṣitāyām bheda abhāva koṭikā vipratipattiḥ mukta tva upalakṣite bheda sādhane śuddha citi bheda mātra siddhyā ātmanaḥ kṛtārtha tā iti yadi manuṣe tarhi ātmatva saṃsāri tva ādi dharmeṣu kasyacid pakṣatā avacchedaka tva anusaraṇe vipratipatteḥ citi bheda siddhi sambhavena siddhasādhanatā doṣeṇa eva

original: mithyāparaparyāyavyāvahārikapadabodhyaṃ vyāvahārikañcāṅgīkṛtyobhayatraikaṃ sāmānyaṃ mamāsampratipannameva| dṛśyatvatvaṃ vyabhicāritāvacchedakatvena tvayaiva svīkṛtam| ato vikalpo yukta evetyāśayena tādṛśasāmānyanirākaraṇaṃ yuktameva| ato na kaściddoṣaḥ|
analyzed: mithyā apara paryāya vyāvahārika pada bodhyam vyāvahārikam ca aṅgīkṛtya ubhayatra ekam sāmānyam mama asampratipannam eva dṛśya tva tvam vyabhicāri tā avacchedaka tvena tvayā eva svīkṛtam atas vikalpaḥ yuktaḥ eva iti āśayena tādṛśa sāmānya nirākaraṇam yuktam eva atas na kaścid doṣaḥ

original: avaśaybhitthameva tadabhiprāyo vācyaḥ| anyathā jagati tāvaddṛśyatvaṃ bhavatāṅgīkṛtam| tatsatyaṃ mithyā vā'mta| tatra dṛśyatvarūpadharmastvayāṅgīkṛta eva| sa ca mithyāsatyobhayavṛttitvena tvayā nābhyupagamyatām| tathā ca tatrānirvicanīyatvasatyatvarūpaviśeṣaṇaprakṣepaṃ vihāya dṛśyatvatvamātreṇa tasya hetutve'bhiprete uktavikalpo'saṅgata eva|
analyzed: avaśaybhi ittham eva tad abhiprāyaḥ vācyaḥ anyathā jagati tāvat dṛśya tvam bhavatā aṅgīkṛtam tat satyam mithyā tatra dṛśya tva rūpa dharmaḥ tvayā aṅgīkṛtaḥ eva sa ca mithyā satya ubhaya vṛtti tvena tvayā na abhyupagamyatām tathā ca tatra anirvicanīya tva satya tva rūpa viśeṣaṇa prakṣepam vihāya dṛśya tva tva mātreṇa tasya hetu tva ibhiprete ukta vikalpa usaṅgataḥ eva

original: anyathā mīmāṃsakanaiyāyikayoḥ varṇeṣu śabde nityatvānityatvarūpasvapakṣasādhanāya pakṣīkaraṇāyogaprasaṅgaḥ| mīmāṃsakairvarṇasya dravyatvamucyate| naiyāyikaistu guṇatvam| dravyātmakavarṇe guṇātmakavarṇe ca varṇatvarūpasāmānyadharmo vartata ityubhābhyāmapi na svīkṛtam|
analyzed: anyathā mīmāṃsaka naiyāyikayoḥ varṇeṣu śabde nitya tva anitya tva rūpa sva pakṣa sādhanāya pakṣīkaraṇa ayoga prasaṅgaḥ mīmāṃsakaiḥ varṇasya dravya tvam ucyate naiyāyikaiḥ tu guṇa tvam dravya ātmaka varṇe guṇa ātmaka varṇe ca varṇa tva rūpa sāmānya dharmaḥ vartate iti ubhābhyām api na svīkṛtam

original: itthañcaikena varṇasya pakṣīkāre pareṇa dravyātmakavarṇasya pakṣatve mama pakṣāprasiddhiḥ| guṇātmakavarṇasya pakṣatve tu tavāprasiddhiḥ ityādidūṣaṇaprasaṅgāt| ata evoktābhiprāyo yuktaḥ|
analyzed: ittham ca ekena varṇasya pakṣīkāre pareṇa dravya ātmaka varṇasya pakṣa tve mama pakṣa aprasiddhiḥ guṇa ātmaka varṇasya pakṣa tve tu tava aprasiddhiḥ ityādi dūṣaṇa prasaṅgāt atas eva ukta abhiprāyaḥ yuktaḥ

original: na ca dhūmāditi hetāvapi ābhāsena vyabhicāravāraṇāya tatra tadvārakaviśeṣaṇasyāvaśyakatve'nyatarāsiddhyādidūṣaṇasya tatrāpi sambhavāttatra sampratipattirayukteti vācyam| uktarītyā dūṣaṇaṃ paramate sarvatrāpi vartata eva|

original: parantu dhūmatvasāmānyāṅgīkartrorvicāre etaddeśasaṃlagnatvādinā vikalpo na kartavya ityatraiva sampratipattistatroktetyalamaprastutavicāreṇa| prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ|

original: tasya vācyatāvacchedakakoṭiniviṣṭatvāt| kiṃ cāsattucchālīkamithyāpadāni paryāyāṇītyavivādam| teṣāmapyatyantābhāvapratiyogyarthatve tatparyāyasya mithyāpadasyātyantābhāvapratiyegitvārthakatvānupapattiḥ| teṣāmapyatyantābhāvapratiyogitvārthakatve śaśaviṣāṇamalīkamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiḥ|

original: parantu śābdabodhānukūlaśaktijñānaṃ `ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭo ghaṭapadaśakyaḥ' ityākāram| na tu `ghaṭatvaghaṭa ghaṭapadaśakyau' ityākāram| ataḥ śābdabodhānukūlajñānaviṣayībhūtaśaktyaṃśe'viśeṣyatvāttatrāśakyatvavyavahāraḥ| evañca tādṛśāpratiyogitvāṃśe viśeṣaṇatayā vācyatvasattvāduktaṭīkā saṅgataiva |

original: na ca mithyādipadānāmuktapratiyogyarthakatve `mithyāpadavācyaṃ nāsti' iti pratītiprasaṅgaḥ| `vācyasāmānyaṃ nāsti'iti pratītestādṛśapratiyogitvarūpavācyasattvena bādhitatvāt| ata eva tādṛśapratiyogitvarūpavācyasya sattvamuktam| `viśeṣyatayā vācyaṃ nāsti' iti pratītistviṣṭaiva| na cāsataḥ kathaṃ vācyatvamiti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca mithyā ādi padānām ukta pratiyogi arthaka tve mithyā pada vācyam na asti iti pratīti prasaṅgaḥ vācya sāmānyam na asti iti pratīteḥ tādṛśa pratiyogitva rūpa vācya sattvena bādhita tvāt atas eva tādṛśa pratiyogitva rūpa vācyasya sattvam uktam viśeṣyatayā vācyam na asti iti pratītiḥ tu iṣṭā eva na ca asataḥ katham vācyatvam iti vācyam

original: viṣayitānirūpakatvarūpoktavācyatvasya tatra sattve bādhakābhāvāt| arthavatsūtrepi śaktimattvarūpārthavattvameva vivakṣitam| na tu sadviśeṣyakabodhajanakatvam| tathātve'līkādipadānāṃ padatvavyāghātaprasaṅgāt|

original: mithyāpadasya tu pratiyogī abhāvaśca pṛthagevārtha ityaṅgīkṛtya pratiyogini samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasyābhedenānvayamaṅgīkṛtyābhāvaprādhānyena bodhaḥ mithyāśabdasthale'nubhavādeva svīkriyate| mithyālīkaśabdayoḥ paryāyatvoktistvanatibhinnārthatvāt| yadyabhāvapradhānakabodhaḥ pāścātya eva darśita ityucyate tadā na kopi doṣaḥ|
analyzed: mithyā padasya tu pratiyogī abhāvaḥ ca pṛthak evā arthaḥ iti aṅgīkṛtya pratiyogini samabhivyāhṛta padārthasya abhedena anvayam aṅgīkṛtya abhāva prādhānyena bodhaḥ mithyā śabda sthale anubhavāt eva svīkriyate mithyā alīka śabdayoḥ paryāya tva uktiḥ tu anatibhinna artha tvāt yadi abhāva pradhānaka bodhaḥ pāścātyaḥ eva darśitaḥ iti ucyate tadā na kaḥ api doṣaḥ

original: māyāvādinastu `asato nirupākhyatvaṃ śabdaśaktyaviṣayatvam' iti vadanto'sataḥ śaktyagocaratāmāhuḥ| tanna| alīkādipadānāṃ teṣāmapadatvāpatteḥ| na ca tānyanirvacanīyavācīnīti vācyam| `śaśaviṣāṇamalīkam' iti vākyasya sarvamate pramāṇasyāpalāpāpattiḥ| na ca tadvākyaṃ vikalpajanakameveti na bodhakatvaghaṭitaprāmāṇyaṃ matsammatamiti vācyam|
analyzed: māyāvādinaḥ tu asataḥ nirupākhya tvam śabda śakti aviṣaya tvam iti vadantaḥ usataḥ śakti agocaratām āhuḥ tat na alīka ādi padānām teṣām apadatva āpatteḥ na ca tāni anirvacanīya vācīni iti vācyam śaśaviṣāṇam alīkam iti vākyasya sarva mate pramāṇasya apalāpa āpattiḥ na ca tat vākyam vikalpa janakam eva iti na bodhakatva ghaṭita prāmāṇyam mad sammatam iti vācyam

original: aprāmāṇikapratiyogikātyantābhāvaniyamavādinastu yatra bhūtale ghaṭasyasarvathā na sambandhastadbhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyādivākyaṃ tadbhūtalavṛttitvaviśiṣṭaghaṭapratiyogikātyantābhāvaṃ bodhayati `na tvetadbhūtale ghaṭābhāvaḥ' iti tadā tadvākyābhilāpyaṃ pratyakṣamapi tādṛśākārameva| bhūtalavṛttitvasya tajjñāne'bhāvāṃśe'bhānepi kṣativirahāt|
analyzed: aprāmāṇika pratiyogika atyantābhāva niyamavādinaḥ tu yatra bhū tale ghaṭasya asarvathā na sambandhaḥ tad bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādi vākyam tad bhū tala vṛttitva viśiṣṭa ghaṭa pratiyogika atyantābhāvam bodhayati na tu etad bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti tadā tad vākya abhilāpyam pratyakṣam api tādṛśa ākāram eva bhū tala vṛttitvasya kṣati virahāt

original: pratyakṣasthale ghaṭasmaraṇottaraṃ bhūtalavṛttitvena ghaṭasya bhānānantaraṃ viśiṣṭasyāsata evābhāvāṃśe bhānam| na ca kāraṇībhūtajñānasyānāhāryatve tādṛśajñānaviṣayapratiyogikaniṣedhabhānānupapattiḥ| etanmate tādṛśajñānasyātraiva virodhitvāt| anyathā bhūtale ghaṭa iti vākyādinā niścitavato'pi tādṛśābhāvabuddhiprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: pratyakṣa sthale ghaṭa smaraṇa uttaram bhū tala vṛtti tvena ghaṭasya bhāna anantaram viśiṣṭasya asataḥ eva abhāva aṃśe bhānam na ca kāraṇībhūta jñānasya anāhārya tve tādṛśa jñāna viṣaya pratiyogika niṣedha bhāna anupapattiḥ etad mate tādṛśa jñānasya atra eva virodhi tvāt anyathā bhū tale ghaṭaḥ iti vākya ādinā niścitavataḥ api tādṛśa abhāva buddhi prasaṅgāt

original: kāraṇībhūtajñānasyā'hāryatve tatra bādhagrahāpekṣā tatrāpi kāraṇatayā punarāhāryagrahāntarāpekṣetyanavasthaiveti vācyam| `bhūtalavṛttirghaṭaḥ' itirūpasya kāraṇībhūtajñānasya tatra sattvānavagāhitayā pratibandhakatvābhāvāt| sattvāvagāhidhiya eva pratibandhakatvātpratibadhyatvācca|
analyzed: kāraṇībhūta jñānasya āhārya tve tatra bādha graha apekṣā tatra api kāraṇatayā punar āhārya graha antara apekṣā iti anavasthā eva iti vācyam bhū tala vṛttiḥ ghaṭaḥ iti rūpasya kāraṇībhūta jñānasya tatra sattva anavagāhi tayā pratibandhaka tva abhāvāt sattva avagāhi dhiyaḥ eva pratibandhaka tvāt pratibadhya tvāt ca

original: nanu sattvānavagāhijñānaṃ bhramaḥ pramā vā| pramaiveti brūmaḥ| na ca tadabhāvavati tatprakārasya kathaṃ pramātvamucyata iti vācyam| svaniścitābhāvakaprativādivākyārthaṃ jñātvā anuvādakasya bhrāntatvena prekṣāvadvyavahṛtyagocaratayā tatra sattvāvagāhitayā vidhirūpatvena vyavahriyamāṇajñānasyaiva bhramatvāṅgīkārāt| ata evoktamācāryaiḥ|
analyzed: nanu sattva anavagāhi jñānam bhramaḥ pramā vā pramā eva iti brūmaḥ na ca tad abhāvavati tad prakārasya katham pramā tvam ucyate iti vācyam sva niścita abhāvaka prativādi vākya artham jñātvā anuvādakasya bhrānta tvena prekṣāvat vyavahṛti agocara tayā tatra sattva avagāhi tayā vidhi rūpa tvena vyavahriyamāṇa jñānasya eva bhrama tva aṅgīkārāt atas eva uktam ācāryaiḥ

original: `asataḥ satvena pratītiḥ sato'sattvena pratītirityanyathāpratītereva bhrāntitvāt' iti| na cānuvāda sthale'nuvādakartṛjñānasyā'hāryabhramatvāttasya svabuddhipūrvaṃ jātatvāttamādāya na tasya bhrāntatvavyavahāragocarateti vācyam|
analyzed: asataḥ sattvena pratītiḥ pratītiḥ iti anyathā pratīteḥ eva bhrānti tvāt iti na ca anuvāda sthalenuvāda kartṛ jñānasya āhārya bhrama tvāt tasya sva buddhi pūrvam jāta tvāt tam ādāya na tasya bhrānta tva vyavahāra gocara tā iti vācyam

original: buddhipūrvaṃ svāṅgavikṛtikartari vikṛtāṅga iti vyavahāragocaratvādbuddhipūrvakabhramasampādakatve sutarāṃ bhrāntavyavahāragocaratvasya durvāratvāt| nirdoṣatvena pramiteṣu yogyādiṣvanuvādakatvadarśanena tanniṣṭhajñānasya doṣājanyatvena bhramatvānupapatteḥ|
analyzed: buddhi pūrvam sva aṅga vikṛti kartari vikṛta aṅgaḥ iti vyavahāra gocara tvāt buddhi pūrvaka bhrama sampādaka tve sutarām bhrānta vyavahāra gocara tvasya durvāra tvāt nirdoṣa tvena pramiteṣu yogi ādiṣu anuvādaka tva darśanena tad niṣṭha jñānasya doṣa ajanya tvena bhrama tva anupapatteḥ

original: ata eva tatra tajjñānaprayojakecchāyā eva doṣatvamiti nirastam| bhramasya tatkāraṇadoṣasya ca tatra tatra bhrāntatvādivyavahārarūpapramāṇaṃ vinā kalpakābhāvāt| anyathā tatpuruṣaniṣṭhatatkālīnānantavāyusaṃyogādivyaktīnāṃ samānādhikaraṇatayā doṣavidhayā kāraṇatvasya kalpanāyā vinigamanāvirahādāpattiriti gauravāpatteḥ|
analyzed: atas eva tatra tad jñāna prayojaka icchāyāḥ eva doṣa tvam iti nirastam bhramasya tad kāraṇa doṣasya ca tatra tatra bhrānta tva ādi vyavahāra rūpa pramāṇam vinā kalpaka abhāvāt anyathā tad puruṣa niṣṭha tad kālīna ananta vāyu saṃyoga ādi vyaktīnām samāna adhikaraṇa tayā doṣa vidhayā kāraṇa tvasya kalpanāyāḥ vinigamana avirahāt āpattiḥ iti gaurava āpatteḥ

original: na ca tajjñānajanakatvena klṛptecchāyā eva doṣatvaṃ kalpyate| na tu vāyusaṃyogasya| tasya janakatvasyāklṛptatvāditi vācyam| icchāyā doṣavidhayā vilakṣaṇakāraṇatāyā aklṛptatayā vinigamakābhāvasyadṛḍhatvāt| tajjñānakāraṇatvena klṛptatatkṣaṇatadadṛṣṭatatsannikarṣānādāya vinigamakābhāvasya durvāratvācca|
analyzed: na ca tad jñāna janaka tvena klṛpta icchāyāḥ eva doṣa tvam kalpyate na tu vāyu saṃyogasya tasya janaka tvasya aklṛpta tvāt iti vācyam icchāyāḥ doṣa vidhayā vilakṣaṇa kāraṇatāyāḥ aklṛpta tayā vinigamaka abhāvasya dṛḍha tvāt tad jñāna kāraṇa tvena klṛpta tad kṣaṇa tad adṛṣṭa tad sannikarṣān ādāya vinigamaka abhāvasya durvāra tvāt ca

original: doṣājanyatveti tasya bhramatvāṅgīkāre tatpāribhāṣikaṃ syāt|
analyzed: doṣa ajanya tva iti tasya bhrama tva aṅgīkāre tat pāribhāṣikam syāt

original: na ca pramātvamapi kathaṃ arthāvyavasthāpakatvāditi vācyam| sattvāvagāhipramāyā evārthaniścāyakatvena sattvānavagāhitayā'rthāvyavasthāpakatvepi bhramabhinnatvamātreṇa pareṣāṃ nirvikalpakasyeva paramātvopapatteḥ| na ca `yathārthajñānaṃ pramā' iti tallakṣaṇāt asya cāyathārthatvātkathaṃ pramātvam|
analyzed: na ca pramā tvam api katham artha avyavasthāpaka tvāt iti vācyam sattva avagāhi pramāyāḥ eva artha niścāyaka tvena sattva anavagāhi tayā artha avyavasthāpaka tve pi bhrama bhinna tva mātreṇa pareṣām nirvikalpakasya iva paramā tva upapatteḥ na ca yathārtha jñānam pramā iti tad lakṣaṇāt asya ca ayathārtha tvāt katham pramā tvam

original: bhramabhinnatvamātreṇa pramātvopacārepi saṃśayaviparyayapramātiriktajñānāṅgīkāraprāptyā'pasiddhāntaḥ syāditi vācyam| yathārthatvaṃ pramāyāṃ nāsadaviṣayakatvarūpam| `śaśaviṣāṇamasat' iti pramāyāmavyāpteḥ| kintu bhramabhinnatvameva| vibhājakavākyasthapramādipadasyāpi tatparatvenāpasiddhāntābhāvāt|
analyzed: bhrama bhinna tva mātreṇa pramā tva upacāre api saṃśaya viparyaya pramā atirikta jñāna aṅgīkāra prāptyā apasiddhāntaḥ syāt iti vācyam yathārtha tvam pramāyām na asat aviṣayaka tva rūpam śaśaviṣāṇam asat iti pramāyām avyāpteḥ kintu bhrama bhinna tvam eva vibhājaka vākya stha pramā ādi padasya api tad para tvena apasiddhānta abhāvāt

original: na ca sattvāsattvānyatarāvagāhitvasya pratītau nityatvena tadaudāsīnyena pratītyanupapatyā kathamasyāḥ pratīteḥ sambhava iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca sattva asattva anyatara avagāhi tvasya pratītau nitya tvena tad audāsīnyena pratīti anupapatyā katham asyāḥ pratīteḥ sambhavaḥ iti vācyam

original: prāmāṇyasvatastvaśyeva tasyautsargitakatayā tasminnasattvagrahasāmagryāḥ kāryakālavṛttitayā virodhitvāṅgīkāreṇa dvitīyakṣaṇa eva niṣedhapratiyogitvarūpāsattvabuddhyutpattyoktajñānādhikaraṇakṣaṇasya sattvagrahasāmagryanadhikaraṇatvāt| na ca sattvagrahābhāvepi uktajñānotpattikṣaṇa eva tatrāsattvabhānāpattiḥ|
analyzed: prāmāṇya svatas tu aśi eva tasya autsargitaka tayā tasmin asattva graha sāmagryāḥ kārya kāla vṛttitayā virodhi tva aṅgīkāreṇa dvitīya kṣaṇe eva niṣedha pratiyogi tva rūpa asattva buddhi utpattyā ukta jñāna adhikaraṇa kṣaṇasya sattva graha sāmagrī anadhikaraṇa tvāt na ca sattva graha abhāve pi ukta jñāna utpatti kṣaṇe eva tatra asattva bhāna āpattiḥ

original: tasya sattvavat jñānotpādakasāmagrīmātragrāhyatvābhāvenāsattvagrāhakasāmagrīṃ vinā prathamatastadgrahāyogāt| na coktajñānasya bhramatvābhāve āropakāraṇatvavacanaṃ yogipraśnakāraṇībhūtasaṃśayasyā'hāryatvavacanaṃ ca prācāṃ viruddhyate| tasya bhramaviśeṣatvāditi vācyam| sattvānavagāhitvena viparītajñānāpratibadhyatayā ca taduktisaṅgateḥ|
analyzed: tasya sattva vat jñāna utpādaka sāmagrī mātra grāhya tva abhāvena asattva grāhaka sāmagrīm vinā prathamatas tad graha ayogāt na ca ukta jñānasya bhrama tva abhāve āropa kāraṇa tva vacanam yogi praśna kāraṇībhūta saṃśayasya āhārya tva vacanam ca prācām viruddhyate tasya bhrama viśeṣa tvāt iti vācyam sattva anavagāhi tvena viparīta jñāna apratibadhya tayā ca tad ukti saṅgateḥ

original: na ca `śaśaśṛṅge sattvaṃ nāsti' iti dhīḥ śaśaśṛṅge sattvajñānapūrvikaiva vācyā| evaṃ `ghaṭe asattvaṃ nāsti' iti dhīrghaṭe'sattvajñānapūrvakaiva vācyā| tathā ca tādṛśaniṣedhajñānavatāṃ bhrāntavyavahāragocaratvāpattiḥ| asataḥ śaśaviṣāṇādeḥ sattvena sato ghaṭāderasattvena ca pratīteḥ sattvāt|
analyzed: na ca śaśa śṛṅge sattvam na asti iti dhīḥ śaśa śṛṅge sattva jñāna pūrvikā eva vācyā evam ghaṭe asattvam na asti iti dhīḥ ghaṭe sattva jñāna pūrvakā eva vācyā tathā ca tādṛśa niṣedha jñānavatām bhrānta vyavahāra gocara tva āpattiḥ asataḥ śaśa viṣāṇa ādeḥ sattvena sataḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ asattvena ca pratīteḥ sattvāt

original: tatra bhāsamānasattvāṃśe'pi sattvāvagāhitvamiti bhramatvapariṣkāre `śuktirajatasattve sattvaṃ nāsti' iti jñānakāraṇībhūtajñānamādāya pūrvokta eva doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tatra bhāsamāna sattva aṃśe api sattva avagāhi tvam iti bhrama tva pariṣkāre śukti rajata sattve sattvam na asti iti jñāna kāraṇībhūta jñānam ādāya pūrvoktaḥ eva doṣaḥ

original: tatra bhāsamānasattve'pi sattvāntarāvagāhitvaṃ niveśya pariṣkāre tatra tatra sattvaniṣedhajñānakāraṇībhūtajñānamādāyoktadoṣavāraṇāyottaratrāpi tathā tathā pariṣkārāvaśyakatve bhrame'navasthitaviṣayatākalpanāpattistaddhaṭitabhramatvasya durgrahatvāpattiśceti vācyam| yato ghaṭādau yatra sattvaṃ bhāsate tatra sattvaṃ svāṃśe svarūpato bhāsate|
analyzed: tatra bhāsamāna sattve api sattva antara avagāhi tvam niveśya pariṣkāre tatra tatra sattva niṣedha jñāna kāraṇībhūta jñānam ādāya ukta doṣa vāraṇāya uttaratra api tathā tathā pariṣkāra āvaśyaka tve bhramena avasthita viṣaya tā kalpanā āpattiḥ tad dhaṭita bhrama tvasya durgraha tva āpattiḥ ca iti vācyam yatas ghaṭa ādau yatra sattvam bhāsate tatra sattvam sva aṃśe svarūpataḥ bhāsate

original: tadeva jñānaṃ ghaṭāṃśe sattvāṃśe cāsattvāvagāhinīṃ dhiyaṃ viruṇaddhi| ghaṭasya sattvaṃ tatsattvasyāpi sattvaṃ tasyāpi sattvamityādinānāvidhavyavahāraṃ janayati| evaṃ `śaśaviṣāṇamasat' iti pratyaye'pyasattve sattvaṃ pratīyata eva| jñānasāmānyasāmagryāḥ sattvāvagāhitāyā apavādābhāve niyatatvāt|
analyzed: tat eva jñānam ghaṭa aṃśe sattva aṃśe ca asattva avagāhinīm dhiyam viruṇaddhi ghaṭasya sattvam tat sattvasya api sattvam tasya api sattvam ityādi nānāvidha vyavahāram janayati evam śaśa viṣāṇam asat iti pratyaye pi asattve sattvam pratīyate eva jñāna sāmānya sāmagryāḥ sattva avagāhi tāyāḥ apavāda abhāve niyata tvāt

original: tatra bhāsamānasattve svayameva sattvaṃ svarūpato bhāsate| atastatra nāsattvasaṃśayādyāpattiḥ| ghaṭābhāvasya svātmakaghaṭābhāvādhāratvatrānamātrasya `ghaṭābhāve ghaṭābhāvaḥ' `ghaṭābhāvavṛttighaṭabhāve ghaṭo nāsti' ityādivyavahāranirvāhakatvavat trikālabādhyatvasāmānyābhāvarūpasattvasya svāṃśe'vagāhijñānasya sattve sattvaṃ tatsattve
analyzed: tatra bhāsamāna sattve svayam eva sattvam svarūpataḥ bhāsate atas tatra na asattva saṃśaya ādi āpattiḥ ghaṭa abhāvasya sva ātmaka ghaṭa abhāva ādhāra tva trāna mātrasya ghaṭa abhāve ghaṭa abhāvaḥ ghaṭa abhāva vṛtti ghaṭa bhāve ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādi vyavahāra nirvāhaka tva vat trikāla bādhya tva sāmānya abhāva rūpa sattvasya sva aṃśa avagāhi jñānasya sattve sattvam tad sattve api anubhūta anubhūta api anubhūta api anubhūta api anubhūta api anubh

original: sattvimityādivyavahāranirvāhakatvamupapannam| evaṃ yathā dravyādiṣaṭ‌kānayonyābhāvasyābhāvatvarūpatāmate `ghaṭo nāsti ghaṭābhāvaḥ' ityādipratyayeṣu abhāve bhāsamānaṃ ṣaṭ‌kānyonyābhāva rūpabhāvatvaṃ svarūpata eva bhāsata ityabhyupeyate|
analyzed: evam yathā dravya ādi ṣaṭka anayonya abhāvasya abhāva tva rūpatā mate ghaṭaḥ na asti ghaṭa abhāvaḥ ityādi pratyayeṣu abhāve bhāsamānam ṣaṭka anyonya abhāva rūpa bhāva tvam svarūpataḥ eva bhāsate iti abhyupeyate

original: anyathā tādṛśānyonyābhāvavattvena bhāne taccharīre punarabhāvatvasyaniviṣṭatayā'navasthitaviṣayatāprasaṅgādabhāvatvenābhāvasya durgrahatvāpatteśca| tathā bādhyatvābhāvarūpasattvasya svāṃśe svarūpato bhānamaviruddham|
analyzed: anyathā tādṛśa anyonya abhāvavat tvena bhāne tad śarīre punar abhāva tvasya niviṣṭa tayā anavasthita viṣayatā prasaṅgāt abhāva tvena abhāvasya durgraha tva āpatteḥ ca tathā bādhya tva abhāva rūpa sattvasya sva aṃśe svarūpataḥ bhānam aviruddham

original: itthañca bhramalakṣaṇeti `asataḥ sattvāvagāhitvam' ityatrānavacchinnasvaviṣayatānirūpitasattvaviṣayatānirūpitāsanniṣṭhaviṣayatāyāḥ `sato asattvenāvagāhitvam' ityanena svarūpataḥ svaviṣayatānirūpitasattvaviṣayatānirūpitā yā'sattvaviṣayatā tadrūpaprakāratānirūpitasanniṣṭaviṣayatāyāśca niveśaḥ|
analyzed: ittham ca bhrama lakṣaṇā iti asataḥ sattva avagāhi tvam iti atra anavacchinna sva viṣayatā nirūpita sattva viṣayatā nirūpita asat niṣṭha viṣayatāyāḥ sataḥ asattvena avagāhi tvam iti anena svarūpataḥ sva viṣayatā nirūpita sattva viṣayatā nirūpitā yā asattva viṣayatā tad rūpa prakāratā nirūpita sanniṣṭa viṣayatāyāḥ ca niveśaḥ

original: na ca `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhramasthāne'sadrajate bhāsamānasattvasyāpyasattvena tasya niḥsvarūpatvena kathaṃ svāṃśe svarūpato bhānamiti vācyam| śuktyādyadhiṣṭhasattvabhāsakasāmagryāḥ sattvena tatsaṃsargamātrasya bhrame rajatādāvāropitatattvāṅgīkāreṇa sattvasyāsattvābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca idam rajatam iti bhrama sthāne sat rajate bhāsamāna sattvasya api asattvena tasya niḥsvarūpa tvena katham sva aṃśe svarūpataḥ bhānam iti vācyam śukti ādi adhiṣṭha sattva bhāsaka sāmagryāḥ sattvena tad saṃsarga mātrasya bhrame rajata ādau āropita tattva aṅgīkāreṇa sattvasya asattva abhāvāt

analyzed: bheda grahe nyonyāśraya ādi parihāraḥ tu dharmi svarūpa tva nirbharam vinā api dharmi tva pratiyogi tva tad bhedāḥ yugapad iti anuvyākhyāna sudhāyām samaya pāde naiyāyika mata pradarśanena kiñca ityādinā viṣṇutatvanirṇayaṭīkāyām ca ṭīkākāraiḥ pradarśitaḥ iti na advaita vādibhiḥ saha vicāre

original: tathā ca prāgabhāvādīnāṃ trayāṇāmapi pratiyoginā saha kālika eva virodha utātyantābhāvaviśeṣasya daiśika evetyatra sphuṭanirṇāyakaviśeṣapramāṇābhāvāllāghavādisahakṛtānumānādyavasara iti|
analyzed: tathā ca prāgabhāva ādīnām trayāṇām api pratiyoginā saha kālikaḥ eva virodhaḥ uta atyanta abhāva viśeṣasya daiśikaḥ eva iti atra sphuṭa nirṇāyaka viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvāt lāghava ādi sahakṛta anumāna ādi avasaraḥ iti

original: api ca svarasato yādṛśaśabdāt yādṛśabodho jāyate tadabhilāpyapratyayasyāpyutsargatastadākāratvaṃ niyatam| evañca bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyatra bhūtalādhikaraṇakasattāvaddhaṭābhāvo bodhyata iti tadabhilāpyapratītestādṛśaviśiṣṭaghaṭapratiyogikābhāvo viṣayo vācyaḥ|
analyzed: api ca svarasataḥ yādṛśa śabdāt yādṛśa bodhaḥ jāyate tad abhilāpya pratyayasya api utsargataḥ tad ākāra tvam niyatam evam ca bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti atra bhū tala adhikaraṇaka sattāvat dhaṭa abhāvaḥ bodhyate iti tad abhilāpya pratīteḥ tādṛśa viśiṣṭa ghaṭa pratiyogika abhāvaḥ viṣayaḥ vācyaḥ

original: yatra bhūtale ghaṭaḥ prasiddhastaddhaṭitaviśiṣṭapratiyogikaḥ prāgabhāvo dhvaṃso vā bhavati| na caivaṃ sati śuddhapratiyogikaprāgabhāvadhvaṃsau na siddhyetāmiti vācyam|
analyzed: yatra bhū tale ghaṭaḥ prasiddhaḥ tad ghaṭita viśiṣṭa pratiyogikaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ dhvaṃsaḥ vā bhavati na ca evam sati śuddha pratiyogika prāgabhāva dhvaṃsau na siddhyetām iti vācyam

original: yatra ghaṭastatsaṃsargaścobhāvapyutpananau naṣṭau vā tatra `ghaṭastatsaṃsargaśca utpatsyate, bhaviṣyati, ghaṭastatsaṃsargaśca naṣṭaḥ' ityādipratyayāntarānurodhena siddhaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyapratiyogikaprāgabhāvadhvaṃsānāmeva viśiṣṭapratiyogikatvena bhānamaṅgīkriyata iti tasya śuddhapratiyogikatvasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: yatra ghaṭaḥ tad saṃsargaḥ ca ubhau api utpananau naṣṭau vā tatra ghaṭaḥ tad saṃsargaḥ ca utpatsyate bhaviṣyati ghaṭaḥ tad saṃsargaḥ ca naṣṭaḥ ityādi pratyaya antara anurodhena siddha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya pratiyogika prāgabhāva dhvaṃsānām eva viśiṣṭa pratiyogika tvena bhānam aṅgīkriyate iti tasya śuddha pratiyogika tva siddhiḥ

original: vastutastu caitro rūpīti caitratvaviśiṣṭe rūpāvagāhipratītyaiva śuddhe'pi rūpitvaṃ siddhyati| anyathā śuddhasyārūpitvaṃ syāt| evaṃ viśiṣṭe pratiyogitvāvagāhipratītyā śuddhe'pi pratiyogitvaṃ viṣayīkriyata eva|
analyzed: vastutas tu caitraḥ rūpī iti caitra tva viśiṣṭe rūpa avagāhi pratītyā eva śuddhe api rūpi tvam siddhyati anyathā śuddhasya arūpi tvam syāt evam viśiṣṭe pratiyogitva avagāhi pratītyā śuddhe api pratiyogitvam viṣayīkriyate eva

original: yadvā mā'stu taddharmaviśiṣṭe pratiyogitvāvagāhitvam| taddharmopalakṣita eva tadavagāhitvamastu| yatra viśeṣyāṃśe tadā bhāsamānābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ bādhitaṃ tatra viśiṣṭe tatra viśeṣaṇībhūtaghaṭabhūtalasaṃsarge vā pratiyogitvaṃ bhāsate| yatra bhūtale ghaṭaḥ sarvathā nāsti tatra ghaṭo nāstīti pratītirjāyate|
analyzed: yat vā mā astu tad dharma viśiṣṭe pratiyogitva avagāhi tvam tad dharma upalakṣite eva tad avagāhi tvam astu yatra viśeṣya aṃśe tadā bhāsamāna abhāva pratiyogitvam bādhitam tatra viśiṣṭe tatra viśeṣaṇībhūta ghaṭa bhū tala saṃsarge vā pratiyogitvam bhāsate yatra bhū tale ghaṭaḥ sarvathā na asti tatra ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratītiḥ jāyate

original: tatra tadbhūtalavṛttighaṭasyāsataḥ pratiyogitvena bhānamiti atyantābhāvasyasarvasyāpyasatpratiyogikatvaṃ siddham| na ca yatra `ghaṭābāvavadbhūtalam' iti pratītirjāyate tatraitadbhūtalāsaṃsṛṣṭasyaiva ghaṭasya pratiyogitayā bhānātsatpratiyogikābhāvo'pi svīkriyatāmiti vācyam|
analyzed: tatra tad bhū tala vṛtti ghaṭasya asataḥ pratiyogitvena bhānam iti atyanta abhāvasya sarvasya api asat pratiyogika tvam siddham na ca yatra ghaṭa abāvavat bhū talam iti pratītiḥ jāyate tatra etad bhū tala asaṃsṛṣṭasya eva ghaṭasya pratiyogitayā bhānāt sat pratiyogika abhāvaḥ api svīkriyatām iti vācyam

original: yatroktapratītiḥ prātyakṣikī tadā tasyā `atra bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' iti prāthamikapratīterāvaśyakatayā tatroktarītyā'sata eva pratiyogitayā bhānāttadviṣayībhūtārthāvagāhinyā dvitīyapratīterapyasatpratiyogikābhāvaviṣayakatvāvaśaykatve ghaṭādipadasyābhilāpakavākyasthasya bhūtalavṛttighaṭādau lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇīyā|
analyzed: yatra ukta pratītiḥ prātyakṣikī tadā tasyāḥ atra bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti prāthamika pratīteḥ āvaśyaka tayā tatra ukta rītyā asataḥ eva pratiyogitayā bhānāt tad viṣayībhūta artha avagāhinyā dvitīya pratīteḥ api asat pratiyogika abhāva viṣayaka tva āvaśayka tve ghaṭa ādi padasya abhilāpaka vākya sthasya bhū tala vṛtti ghaṭa ādau lakṣaṇā āśrayaṇīyā

original: yatra `ghaṭābhāvavadidam' ityānumānikaḥ pratyayaḥ śādbo vā tatrādhikaraṇe `atra ghaṭo nāsti' iti pratyayasya kadācitkasyacidapi durapahnavatayoktānumānikādyabhāvapratyayasyāpi tadviṣayatvamiti rītyopapatteḥ|
analyzed: yatra ghaṭa abhāvavat idam iti ānumānikaḥ pratyayaḥ vā tatra adhikaraṇe atra ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratyayasya kadācid kasyacid api durapahnava tayā ukta ānumānika ādi abhāva pratyayasya api tad viṣaya tvam iti rītyā upapatteḥ

original: na ca `bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' iti vākyāt `ghaṭābhāvo bhūtalādhikaraṇakasattāśrayaḥ' `bhūtalavṛttighaṭābhāvaḥ sattāśrayaḥ' iti vā bodhaḥ svīkriyata iti tadabhilāpyapratīterapi tatsamānaviṣayakatayā ghaṭapratiyogikatvāvagāhitayā nāsatpratiyogikatvasiddhiriti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti vākyāt ghaṭa abhāvaḥ bhū tala adhikaraṇaka sattā āśrayaḥ bhū tala vṛtti ghaṭa abhāvaḥ sattā āśrayaḥ iti vā bodhaḥ svīkriyate iti tad abhilāpya pratīteḥ api tad samāna viṣayaka tayā ghaṭa pratiyogika tva avagāhitayā na asat pratiyogika tva siddhiḥ iti vācyam

original: naño niyatatvena tadupasthāpye ākhyātādyarthasyānvayāyogāduktarītyā bodhasya vaktumaśakyatvāt| anyathā `bhūtalavṛttighaṭābhāvo dṛśyo bhavati' ityādyarthe uktavākyaprayogavat `bhūtale ghaṭo na dṛśyo bhavati' iti `bhūtale ghaṭo na prameyaḥ' ityādiprayogasya prasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: nañaḥ niyata tvena tad upasthāpye ākhyāta ādi arthasya anvaya ayogāt ukta rītyā bodhasya vaktum aśakya tvāt anyathā bhū tala vṛtti ghaṭa abhāvaḥ dṛśyaḥ bhavati ityādi arthe ukta vākya prayoga vat bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na dṛśyaḥ bhavati iti bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na prameyaḥ ityādi prayogasya prasaṅgaḥ

original: `bhratale ghaṭau na staḥ' `bhūtale ghaṭā na santi' ityādau ākhyātasya dvicanabahuvacanānupapatteśca| abhāvasyaikatvena dvitvādyanupapatteḥ| na hi tatra abhāvadvayaṃ trayaṃ vā bodhyate| tathātvāṅgīkāre ekadvighaṭādhikaraṇe tādṛśapratyayānudayāpatteḥ|
analyzed: bhra tale ghaṭau na staḥ bhū tale ghaṭāḥ na santi ityādau ākhyātasya dvicana bahuvacana anupapatteḥ ca abhāvasya eka tvena dvi tva ādi anupapatteḥ na hi tatra abhāva dvayam trayam vā bodhyate tathātva aṅgīkāre eka dvi ghaṭa adhikaraṇe tādṛśa pratyaya anudaya āpatteḥ

original: na ca tarhi `ghaṭakartṛkasattābhāvo bhūtalavṛttiḥ' iti vā `bhūtalavṛttyabhāvīya pratiyogī ghaṭa sattāśrayaḥ' iti vābodhaḥ svīkriyatām| tāvatā'pi prāmāṇikapratiyogikatvākṣateriti vācyam| ādyakalpe bhūtalapadottaraṃ saptamyanupapatteḥ| tasyāḥ dhātvarthanirūpitādhikaraṇārthakatva evānuśiṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: na ca tarhi ghaṭa kartṛka sattā abhāvaḥ bhū tala vṛttiḥ iti vā bhū tala vṛtti abhāvīya pratiyogī ghaṭa sattā āśrayaḥ iti vā bodhaḥ svīkriyatām tāvatā api prāmāṇika pratiyogika tva akṣateḥ iti vācyam ādya kalpe bhū tala pada uttaram saptamī anupapatteḥ tasyāḥ dhātvartha nirūpita adhikaraṇa arthaka tve eva anuśiṣṭa tvāt

original: ataḥ sattāyāmevānvayasya vaktavyatayā bhūtalādhikaraṇakaghaṭakartṛkasattābhāvabodha evāṅgīkārya iti siddhamaprāmāṇikapratiyogikābhāvaviṣayatvam| dvitīyakalpastvayukta eva| tathātve `sarvatra śaśaviṣaṇaṃ nāsti' iti vākyādasyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt| śaśaviṣāṇe sattāyā bādhitatvāt| naiyāyikamate'pi `bhūtale gaganaṃ nāsti' iti vākyasyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: atas sattāyām eva anvayasya vaktavya tayā bhū tala adhikaraṇaka ghaṭa kartṛka sattā bhāva bodhaḥ eva aṅgīkāryaḥ iti siddham aprāmāṇika pratiyogika abhāva viṣayatvam dvitīya kalpaḥ tu ayuktaḥ eva tathātve sarvatra śaśa viṣaṇam na asti iti vākyāt asya aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt śaśa viṣāṇe sattāyāḥ bādhita tvāt naiyāyika mate api bhū tale gaganam na asti iti vākyasya aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt

original: `hnadavṛttyabhāvapratiyogī vahniḥ parvatavṛttiḥ' iti bodhatātparyeṇa `hade parvate vahnirnāsti' iti prayogaprasaṅgācca| tasmāduktarītyaiva bodho yuktaḥ|
analyzed: vahniḥ parvata vṛttiḥ iti bodha tātparyeṇa hade parvate vahniḥ na asti iti prayoga prasaṅgāt ca tasmāt ukta rītyā eva bodhaḥ yuktaḥ

original: kiñca `bhūtale ghaṭo'sti kim' iti pṛṣṭe `na' ityuttarayati. tatra kiṃpadātiriktapraśnabhāgārthānvitārthabodhakatvasyottaravākye klṛptatayā tadvākyabodhyaviśiṣṭapratiyogikābhāvabodhasya tadvākye klṛptatvādanyatrāpi tathaiva bodha āvaśyakaḥ| `nedaṃ caitrasya' ityādau caitrasambandhaviśiṣṭedaṃpadārthamya asattvena tadabhāvo bodhyate|
analyzed: kiñca bhū tale ghaṭaḥ asti kim iti pṛṣṭe na iti uttarayati tatra kiṃpada atirikta praśna bhāga artha anvita artha bodhakatvasya uttaravākye klṛptatayā tad vākya bodhya viśiṣṭa pratiyogika abhāva bodhasya tad vākye klṛpta tvāt anyatra api tathā eva bodhaḥ āvaśyakaḥ na idam caitrasya ityādau caitra sambandha viśiṣṭa idam padārthasya asattvena tad abhāvaḥ bodhyate

original: na ca ṣaṣṭhyarthacaitrasambandhābhāva evedamarthe pratyāyyatām| ghaṭo nāstītyādāvivātra bādhakābhāvāt. tathā ca prāmāṇikapratiyogikābhāvasiddhiriti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca ṣaṣṭhī artha caitra sambandha abhāvaḥ eva idam arthe pratyāyyatām ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādau iva atra bādhaka abhāvāt tathā ca prāmāṇika pratiyogika abhāva siddhiḥ iti vācyam

original: caitrasambandhārthakasarvanāmatatpadaghaṭitena `tadatra nāsti' iti vākyena bodhyā bhāvātiriktaprāmāṇikapratiyogikābhāvāntarasya tadvākyena bodhane gauraveṇoktarītyā'satpratiyogikābhāvaviṣayakabodhajanakatvasyaivāṅgīkārāt| evaṃ `caitro na pacati' ityasyātyantābhāvabodhakatve'pyeṣaiva gatirūhyā|
analyzed: caitra sambandha arthaka sarvanāma tad pada ghaṭitena tat atra na asti iti vākyena bodhyā bhāva atirikta prāmāṇika pratiyogika abhāva antarasya tad vākyena bodhane gauraveṇa uktarītyā asat pratiyogika abhāva viṣayaka bodha janakatvasya eva aṅgīkārāt evam caitraḥ na pacati iti asya atyanta abhāva bodhaka tve pi eṣā eva gatiḥ ūhyā

original: nanvevaṃ pūrvoktayuktibhiḥ `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati' ityanenāpi paṭakartṛkabhavanāśrayaghaṭābhāvabodhotpattyāpattyā tasya ghaṭasyāprāmāṇikatayoktavākyasyātyantābhāvabodhakatvameva syāt| na bhedabodhakatvam|
analyzed: nanu evam pūrva ukta yuktibhiḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti anena api paṭa kartṛka bhavana āśraya ghaṭa abhāva bodha utpatti āpattyā tasya ghaṭasya aprāmāṇika tayā ukta vākyasya atyanta abhāva bodhaka tvam eva syāt na bheda bodhaka tvam

original: tathā ca `nānyonyābhāvatā pṛthak' iti tatvavivekamūlavyākhyāvasare bhāvaśabdasya kartṛghañantatvamabhyupetyānyonyaṃ na bhavatīti vyutpattyā `anyonyābhāvaśabdena bhedavān bodhyate. taduttarabhāvapratyayena punaranyonyābhāvo bodhyate' iti ṭīkākṛdvyākhyānaṃ viruddhyeteti cenna|
analyzed: tathā ca na anyonya abhāvatā pṛthak iti tatvaviveka mūla vyākhyā avasare bhāva śabdasya kartṛ ghañ anta tvam abhyupetya anyonyam na bhavati iti vyutpattyā anyonya abhāva śabdena bhedavān bodhyate tad uttara bhāva pratyayena punar anyonya abhāvaḥ bodhyate iti ṭīkākṛt vyākhyānam ced na

original: yato `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati' ityatra nañarthe bhede paṭasya pratiyogitayānvayaḥ| tasya ca bhavanarūpāsādhāraṇadharme abhedenānvayaḥ| sarvatra nāmārthayorabhedānvayanaye `ghaṭo na paṭaḥ' ityatra bhedavallākṣaṇikanañarthasya itarapadārthe abhedānvayasyāṅgīkṛtatvena prakṛte nañarthasya bhedasya bhavane abhedānvaye kṣativirahāt|
analyzed: yatas ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti atra nañ arthe bhede paṭasya pratiyogitayā anvayaḥ tasya ca bhavana rūpa asādhāraṇa dharme abhedena anvayaḥ sarvatra nāma arthayoḥ abheda anvaya naye ghaṭaḥ na paṭaḥ iti atra bheda vat lākṣaṇika nañ arthasya itara padārthe abheda anvayasya aṅgīkṛta tvena prakṛte nañ arthasya bhedasya bhavane abheda anvaye kṣati virahāt

original: tathā ca paṭabhedātmakāsādhāraṇadharmāśrayo ghaṭa iti bodhaḥ| ghaṭasvarūpabhedasya ghaṭāsādhāraṇatvamanapavādam|
analyzed: tathā ca paṭa bheda ātmaka asādhāraṇa dharma āśrayaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti bodhaḥ ghaṭa svarūpa bhedasya ghaṭa asādhāraṇa tvam anapavādam

original: yadvā bhavanaṃ svarūpasattā ghaṭabhedasvarūpā ghaṭaniṣṭhā bhavatīti na doṣaḥ| athavā `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati' ityatra paṭasyaiva svarūpasattārūpabhavane āśrayatayā'nvayaḥ| tathā ca `paṭakartṛkabhavanāśrayabhinno ghaṭaḥ' iti bodhaḥ ākhyātasyāśrayarūpakartrarthakatvapakṣe ākhyātārthapratiyogikabhedāvagāhī jāyate|
analyzed: yat vā bhavanam sva rūpa sattā ghaṭa bheda sva rūpā ghaṭa niṣṭhā bhavati iti na doṣaḥ athavā ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti atra paṭasya eva sva rūpa sattā rūpa bhavane āśrayatayā anvayaḥ tathā ca paṭa kartṛka bhavana āśraya bhinnaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti bodhaḥ ākhyātasya āśraya rūpa kartṛ arthaka tva pakṣe ākhyāta artha pratiyogika bheda avagāhī jāyate

original: atha vā'sminneva pakṣe paṭasya dhātvarthabhavanānvitākhyātārthāśraye abhedenānvayaḥ. tathā ca `paṭarūpabhavanakartṛbhedavān ghaṭaḥ' iti bodho jāyate|
analyzed: atha vā asmin eva pakṣe paṭasya dhātvartha bhavana anvita ākhyātārtha āśraye abhedena anvayaḥ tathā ca paṭa rūpa bhavana kartṛ bhedavān ghaṭaḥ iti bodhaḥ jāyate

original: atha vā paṭānvitadhātvarthabhavanarūpasattāyā nañarthābhāvarūpabhede tasyākhyātārthe kartari āśrayarūpe tasya ghaṭe anvayaḥ| `na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityādau `kalañjabhakṣaṇābhāvaviṣayakaṃ kāryam' iti bodhābhyupagantṝṇāṃ gurūṇāṃ mata iva dhātvarthākhyātārthayorantarā nañarthabhānābhyupagamasambhavāt|
analyzed: atha vā paṭa anvita dhātvartha bhavana rūpa sattāyāḥ nañartha abhāva rūpa bhede tasya ākhyātārthe kartari āśraya rūpe tasya ghaṭe anvayaḥ na kalañjam bhakṣayet ityādau kalañja bhakṣaṇa abhāva viṣayakam kāryam iti bodha abhyupagantṝṇām gurūṇām mate iva dhātvartha ākhyātārthayoḥ antarā nañartha bhāna abhyupagama sambhavāt

original: `nāmūḍhasyetarotpatteḥ' `nānupamṛdya prādurbhāvāt' ityādau pañcamīprakṛtipratiyogikābhāvasya pañcamyarthānvayasyābhiyuktairaṅgīkṛtatvācca| etatkalpe paṭakartṛkasattābhāvastadbhedarūpa eva bhavatīti sarvapakṣeṣvapi bhedabodhakatānirvāhaḥ|
analyzed: na amūḍhasya itara utpatteḥ na an upamṛdya prādurbhāvāt ityādau pañcamī prakṛti pratiyogika abhāvasya pañcamī artha anvayasya abhiyuktaiḥ aṅgīkṛta tvāt ca etad kalpe paṭa kartṛka sattā bhāvaḥ tad bheda rūpaḥ eva bhavati iti sarva pakṣeṣu api bheda bodhaka tā nirvāhaḥ

original: nanu kuta evamāśrīyate| paṭakartṛkasattāvaddhaṭaniṣedhaḥ kiṃ na syāt `bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' ityādāviveti cenna| tatra ghaṭakartṛkasattābhāvasya bhūtale bodhane bhūtala iti saptamyanupapatternañarthe ākhyātārthānvaye pūrvoktānupapatteriva uktarītyā bodhāṅgīkāre prathamādyanupapatterabhāvāt| na ca `ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati kim' iti pṛṣṭe `na' iti brūte|
analyzed: nanu kutas evam āśrīyate paṭa kartṛka sattāvat dhaṭa niṣedhaḥ kim na syāt bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādau iva iti ced na tatra ghaṭa kartṛka sattā bhāvasya bhū tale bodhane bhū tale iti saptamī anupapatteḥ nañ arthe ākhyātārtha anvaye pūrvokta anupapatteḥ iva ukta rītyā bodha aṅgīkāre prathama ādi anupapatteḥ abhāvāt na ca ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati kim iti pṛṣṭe na iti brūte

original: tatra paṭakartṛkabhavanaviśiṣṭaghaṭaniṣedhabodhakatvaṃ tadvākyasya pūrvaṃ bhavaduktarītyaiva tavāvaśyakam| evaṃ `ghaṭe paṭatādātmyaṃ nāsti' ityabhilāpānurodhāt tādṛśapratīterghaṭaniṣṭhapaṭatādātmyābhāvaviṣayakatvasya klṛptatvāttadanusāreṇa `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati' iti pratīterapi `nedaṃ caitrasya' ityādāvuktarītyā
analyzed: tatra paṭa kartṛka bhavana viśiṣṭa ghaṭa niṣedha bodhaka tvam tad vākyasya pūrvam bhavat ukta rītyā eva tava āvaśyakam evam ghaṭe paṭa tādātmyam na asti iti abhilāpa anurodhāt tādṛśa pratītyāḥ ghaṭa niṣṭha paṭa tādātmya abhāva viṣayaka tvasya klṛpta tvāt tad anusāreṇa ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti pratītyāḥ api na idam caitrasya ityādau ukta rītyā

original: ghaṭaniṣṭhapaṭatādātmyābhāvaviṣayakatvameva vācyamiti kuto'syāḥ bhedaviṣayakatvapratyāśeti vācyam| `ghaṭaḥ paṭātpṛthak' iti śabdābhilāpyapratīterniṣedhaviṣayakatvenānubhavasiddhāyā atyantābhāvavilakṣaṇabhedaviṣayakatvamāvaśyakam| evaṃ `ghaṭa evāyam' ityetāvanmātrākārapratyayasyāpi svarūpabhedarūpavilakṣaṇaviṣayakatvaṃ durapahnavam|
analyzed: ghaṭa niṣṭha paṭa tādātmya abhāva viṣayakatvam eva vācyam iti kutas asyāḥ bheda viṣayakatva pratyāśā iti vācyam ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak iti śabda abhilāpya pratīteḥ niṣedha viṣayaka tvena anubhava siddhāyāḥ atyanta abhāva vilakṣaṇa bheda viṣayakatvam āvaśyakam evam ghaṭaḥ eva ayam iti etāvat mātra ākāra pratyayasya api svarūpa bheda rūpa vilakṣaṇa viṣayakatvam durapahnavam

original: `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' ityatrāpi `nāsti' ityādipratyaye bhāsamānānuyogitāvilakṣaṇabhedatvādirūpānuyogitāviśiṣṭaviṣayakatvamanubhavasiddham| na cābhilāpakavākye `bhavati' ityasyādhyāhriyamāṇatvātpaṭabhavanaviśiṣṭaghaṭarūpāsata evātyantābhāvarūpaniṣedhapratiyogitvena bhānaṃ tatreti vācyam| sārvajanīnānubhavavirodhāt|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ naḥ iti atra api na asti ityādi pratyaye bhāsamāna anuyogitā vilakṣaṇa bheda tva ādi rūpa anuyogitā viśiṣṭa viṣayaka tvam anubhava siddham na ca abhilāpaka vākye bhavati iti asya adhyāhriyamāṇa tvāt paṭa bhavana viśiṣṭa ghaṭa rūpa asataḥ eva atyanta abhāva rūpa niṣedha pratiyogitvena bhānam tatra iti vācyam sārvajanīna anubhava virodhāt

original: prasajyapratiṣedho'yaṃ kriyayā saha yatra nañ|
analyzed: prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ iyam kriyayā saha yatra nañ

original: paryudāsaḥ sa vijñeyo yatrottarapadena nañ||
analyzed: paryudāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ yatra uttara padena nañ

original: iti kārikayā'bhiyuktaiḥ `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' ityādāvuttarapadarūpapaṭapadārthānvitasvārtharūpabhedabodhakatvena nañaḥ paryudāsasaṃjñakatvoktyā atra kriyādhyāhāraṃ vinaiva bodhasyoktatvāt. prasajyapratiṣedhātmakasaṃsargābhāvabodhasthale kriyāyā āvaśyakatvoktyā tatrāśrutakriyādhyāhārasyāvaśyakatvāt|
analyzed: iti kārikayā abhiyuktaiḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ naḥ ityādau uttara pada rūpa paṭa padārtha anvita sva artha rūpa bheda bodhaka tvena nañaḥ paryudāsa saṃjñaka tva uktyā atra kriyā adhyāhāram vinā eva bodhasya ukta tvāt prasajya pratiṣedha ātmaka saṃsarga abhāva bodha sthale kriyāyāḥ āvaśyaka tva uktyā tatra aśruta kriyā adhyāhārasya āvaśyaka tvāt

original: `aghaṭaṃ bhūtalam' `nirmakṣikam' ityādau kriyāṃ vinā'tyantābhāvabodhakatvaṃ tādṛśasamāsavidhāyakaśāstrabalādeva siddhyati| tatrāsatpratiyogikābhāvabhānanirvāhaḥ pūrvoktarītyā lakṣaṇayā bodhyaḥ| evañcoktapratītibhirabhedasyāpi klṛptatvena `ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati' iti vākyasya tadabhilāpyapratyayasya ca tadviṣayakatvakalpane gauravābhāvāt|
analyzed: aghaṭam bhū talam nirmakṣikam ityādau kriyām vinā atyanta abhāva bodhaka tvam tādṛśa samāsa vidhāyaka śāstra balāt eva siddhi ati tatra asat pratiyogika abhāva bhāna nirvāhaḥ pūrvokta rītyā lakṣaṇayā bodhyaḥ evam ca ukta pratītibhiḥ abhedasya api klṛpta tvena ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati iti vākyasya tad abhilāpya pratyayasya ca tad viṣayaka tva kalpane gaurava abhāvāt

original: `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na' iti vākyajanyabodhasya yatkāryaṃ madhye jñānāntaraṃ vinā `ghaṭaḥ paṭātpṛthak' iti vyavahārādi tajjanakatvādinā `ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati' iti vākyajanyabodhasya tatsamānaviṣayakatvasya niṣpratyūhatayoktarītyā'nyonyābhāvababodhakatvaṃ nirābādhamiti yuktaiva tatvavivekaṭīkā|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na iti vākya janya bodhasya yat kāryam madhye jñāna antaram vinā ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak iti vyavahāra ādi tad janaka tva ādinā ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na bhavati iti vākya janya bodhasya tad samāna viṣayaka tvasya niṣpratyūha tayā ukta rītyā anyonya abhāva babodhaka tvam nirābādham iti yuktā eva tatvavivekaṭīkā

original: `ghaṭaḥ paṭo bhavati kim' ityuttaravākyasthanañ‌padasamabhivyāhṛtena paṭabhavaniviśiṣṭaghaṭaniṣedho bodhyatāṃ nāma kvacit| na hyetāvatā'nantaramuktayuktyā siddhamuktavākyasyānyonyābhāvaviṣayakatvaṃ hīyate| `ghaṭe paṭatādātmyaṃ nāsti' ityasmāddhaṭavṛttipaṭatādātmyarūpāsatpratiyogikātyantābhāvasya bodhaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati kim iti uttara vākya stha nañ pada samabhivyāhṛtena paṭa bhava ni viśiṣṭa ghaṭa niṣedhaḥ bodhyatām nāma kvacid na hi etāvatā anantaram ukta yuktyā siddham ukta vākyasya anyonya abhāva viṣayaka tvam hīyate ghaṭe paṭa tādātmyam na asti iti asmāt dhaṭa vṛtti paṭa tādātmya rūpa asat pratiyogika atyanta abhāvasya bodhaḥ

original: talliṅgakabhedānumitermānasajñānasya votpattyaiva `ghaṭaḥ paṭātpṛthak' iti vyavahārādikāryamaṅgīkriyate| tādātmyābhāvasya bhedavyāpyatāgraharahitānāṃ tadanudayāditi sarvamanavadyam|
analyzed: tad liṅgaka bheda anumiteḥ mānasa jñānasya vā utpattyā eva ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak iti vyavahāra ādi kāryam aṅgīkriyate tādātmya abhāvasya bheda vyāpya tā graha rahitānām tad anudayāt iti sarvam anavadyam

original: kecittu prāmāṇikapratiyogikasyātyantābhāvasyāṅgīkāre tadvadbhedasyaiva tadatyantābhāvarūpatāyā naiyāyikairaṅgīkṛtatvena prakṛtayorbhede mānābhāvena ca tatraiva paryavasānādavyāpyavṛttyatyantābhāvasya siddhānte'naṅgīkārāt so'tyantābhāvo bheda eva|
analyzed: kecid tu prāmāṇika pratiyogikasya atyantābhāvasya aṅgīkāre tadvat bhedasya eva tad atyanta abhāva rūpa tāyāḥ naiyāyikaiḥ aṅgīkṛta tvena prakṛtayoḥ bhede māna abhāvena ca tatra eva paryavasānāt avyāpya vṛtti atyanta abhāvasya siddhāntena aṅgīkārāt saḥ utyantābhāvaḥ bhedaḥ eva

original: śuddhātyantābhāvastu kevalānvayī aprāmāṇikapratiyogika eveti śuddhātyantābhāvasyāprāmāṇikapratiyogikatvaniyamasya na kācatkṣatiḥ|
analyzed: śuddha atyanta abhāvaḥ tu kevala anvayī aprāmāṇika pratiyogikaḥ eva iti śuddha atyanta abhāvasya aprāmāṇika pratiyogika tva niyamasya na kācana kṣatiḥ

original: atyantābhāvasya śuddhatvantu yādṛśayādṛśapratiyogikātyantābhāvatvaviśiṣṭādhikaraṇaṃ yadyat tattatsvarūpabhūtabhedaniṣṭhātyantābhāvatvanirūpikā yā yā tādṛśatādṛśapratiyogitā tattadanyapratiyogitānirūpakātyantābhāvatvavattvam|
analyzed: atyantābhāvasya śuddha tvantu yādṛśa yādṛśa pratiyogika atyantābhāva tva viśiṣṭa adhikaraṇam yat yat tat tad svarūpa bhūta bheda niṣṭha atyantābhāva tva nirūpikā yā yā tādṛśa tādṛśa pratiyogitā tad tad anya pratiyogitā nirūpaka atyantābhāva tva vat tvam

original: yādṛśī ghaṭātyantābhāvīyaghaṭaniṣṭhapratiyogitā tannirūpakātyantābhāvatvaviśiṣṭādhikaraṇāni ghaṭavadbhinnāni nānādhikaraṇāni tattadātmakabhedāstu tattatsvarūpabhūtaghaṭavadbhedāḥ tanniṣṭhātyantābhāvatvaṃ ghaṭātyantābhāvatvaṃ, prāmāṇikapratiyogikātyantābhāvasya bhedarūpatāyā upapāditatvāt|
analyzed: yādṛśī ghaṭa atyantābhāvīya ghaṭa niṣṭha pratiyogitā tad nirūpaka atyantābhāva tva viśiṣṭa adhikaraṇāni ghaṭa vat bhinnāni nānā adhikaraṇāni tad tad ātmaka bhedāḥ tu tad tad svarūpa bhūta ghaṭa vat bhedāḥ tad niṣṭha atyantābhāva tvam ghaṭa atyantābhāva tvam prāmāṇika pratiyogika atyantābhāvasya bheda rūpa tāyāḥ upapādita tvāt

original: tannirūpikāḥ yā yāḥ pratiyogitāḥ prāmāṇikaghaṭādiniṣṭhā eva| tattadanyā śaśaviṣāṇādirūpā'sanniṣṭhā bhavati| tasyā yādṛśapadenopādānāsambhavāt| tathā hi, śaśaviṣāṇādiniṣṭhapratiyogitā yādṛśī cet tannirūpakātyantābhāvatvaviśiṣṭādhikaraṇaṃ yadyat bhūtalādikaṃ tattadātmakabhedāstu padārthāntarapratiyogikabhedāḥ|
analyzed: tad nirūpikāḥ yāḥ yāḥ pratiyogitāḥ prāmāṇika ghaṭa ādi niṣṭhāḥ eva tad tad anyā śaśaviṣāṇa ādi rūpa asat niṣṭhā bhavati tasyāḥ yādṛśa padena upādāna asambhavāt tathā hi śaśaviṣāṇa ādi niṣṭha pratiyogitā yādṛśī ced tad nirūpaka atyanta abhāva tva viśiṣṭa adhikaraṇam yat yat bhū tala ādikam tad tad ātmaka bhedāḥ tu padārtha antara pratiyogika bhedāḥ

original: tanniṣṭhaṃ yadatyantābhāvatvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇābhāvatvaṃ tasya dharmisvarūpatvābhāvena tadātmakabhedarūpatvābhāvāt| kintūktarītyā ghaṭātyantābhāvatvameva| tannirūpakatvaṃ na śaśaviṣāṇādiniṣṭhapratiyogitāyā iti| atra yadyadadhikaraṇamitivīpsānādare śaśaviṣāṇaniṣṭhapratiyogitā'pi tādṛśī bhavatyeva|
analyzed: tad niṣṭham yat atyanta abhāva tvam śaśa viṣāṇa abhāva tvam tasya dharmi svarūpa tva abhāvena tad ātmaka bheda rūpa tva abhāvāt kintu ukta rītyā ghaṭa atyanta abhāva tvam eva tad nirūpaka tvam na śaśa viṣāṇa ādi niṣṭha pratiyogitāyāḥ iti atra yat yat adhikaraṇam iti vīpsā anādare śaśa viṣāṇa niṣṭha pratiyogitā api tādṛśī bhavati eva

original: śaśaviṣāṇābhāvasya svasminnapi sattvāt śaśaviṣāṇaniṣṭhapratiyogitākātyantābhāvatvaviśiṣṭādhikaraṇaṃ śaśaviṣāṇābhāvo'pi| tadātmako bhedastanniṣṭhaghaṭabhedaḥ| tanniṣṭhamatyantābhāvatvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇātyantābhāvatvam| tannirūpakatvāt| atastadādaraḥ|
analyzed: śaśa viṣāṇa abhāvasya svasmin api sattvāt śaśa viṣāṇa niṣṭha pratiyogitāka atyanta abhāva tva viśiṣṭa adhikaraṇam śaśa viṣāṇa abhāvaḥ api tad ātmakaḥ bhedaḥ tad niṣṭha ghaṭa bhedaḥ tad niṣṭham atyanta abhāva tvam śaśa viṣāṇa atyanta abhāva tvam tad nirūpaka tvāt atas tad ādaraḥ

original: yādṛśapratiyogitākābhāvādhikaraṇamityetāvatā pūrtāvatyantābhāvatvāśrayetyuktiranyātyantābhāvapratiyogitā yādṛśapadenopādeyeti sūcanāya| na tvatiprasaṅgaparihārāyeti jñātavyam|
analyzed: yādṛśa pratiyogitāka abhāva adhikaraṇam iti etāvatā pūrtau atyanta abhāva tva āśrayā iti uktiḥ anyā atyanta abhāva pratiyogitā yādṛśa padena upādeyā iti sūcanāya na tu atiprasaṅga parihārāya iti jñātavyam

original: yadvā vyatirekibhinnatvameva śuddhatvam| tattaddharmisvarūpabhedātmakānāṃ prāmāṇikapratiyogikātyantābhāvānāṃ vyatirekitvāttena tadvāraṇam|
analyzed: yat vā vyatireki bhinna tvam eva śuddha tvam tad tad dharmi svarūpa bheda ātmakānām prāmāṇika pratiyogika atyanta abhāvānām vyatireki tvāt tena tad vāraṇam

original: etena `bhedānyatvaṃ cecchuddhatvaṃ tadā śaśaviṣāṇābhāvādīnāmapi svaniṣṭhaghabhedasvarūpatvādasagraha eva svāśrayatvena svāśrayasvarūpabhedātmakatvāt' iti parāstam| uktinirvacanadvaye'pi doṣābhāvāt|
analyzed: etena bheda anyatvam ced śuddha tvam tadā śaśaviṣāṇa abhāva ādīnām api eva sva āśraya tvena sva āśraya svarūpa bheda ātmaka tvāt iti parāstam ukti nirvacana dvaye pi doṣa abhāvāt

original: na ca ghaṭatvātyantābhāvasya paṭātmakabhedasvarūpatve paṭasvarūpasvādhikaraṇātmakatvāpattyā'tyantābhāvasyādhikaraṇasvarūpatvakhaṇḍakasudhātatvasaṃkhyānaṭīkādivirodhaḥ| tatrābhāvatvenaiva rūpeṇa prastutatayā śuddhātyantābhāvaghaṭatatsaṃsargadhvaṃsaprāgabhāvādiparatvāt|
analyzed: na ca ghaṭa tva atyantābhāvasya paṭa ātmaka bheda svarūpa tve paṭa svarūpa sva adhikaraṇa ātmaka tva āpattyā atyantābhāvasya adhikaraṇa svarūpa tva khaṇḍaka sudhā tatva saṃkhyāna ṭīkā ādi virodhaḥ tatra abhāva tvena eva rūpeṇa prastuta tayā śuddha atyantābhāva ghaṭa tad saṃsarga dhvaṃsa prāgabhāva ādi paratvāt

original: nanu vyadhikaraṇasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākarūpātyantābhāvādīnāṃ tadavacchinnabhedāprasiddhyā tadanātmakānāṃ kevalānvayināṃ śuddhātyantābhāvatvavatāṃ prāmāṇikapratiyogikānāmasatpratiyogikatvābhāvādvyabhicāraḥ| na ca tena sambandhena tadvadbhedo'pi tadatyantābhāvarūpaḥ kevalānvayīti noktaśuddhatvaṃ tasyeti vācyam|

analyzed: yatra bhū tale ghaṭaḥ usti tad bhū tala saṃsṛṣṭa ghaṭa pratiyogika atyanta abhāvasya asattvena etad bhū tala saṃsṛṣṭasya tasya sutarām asattvena tad pratiyogika atyanta abhāvasya tad bodha viṣayasya sattvāt bhū tala antara saṃsṛṣṭa ghaṭa pratiyogika atyanta abhāva rūpa kevala anvayi vastu bodhaka tad pada ghaṭitam atra sa na asti iti vākyam apramāṇam eva

original: etadbhūtalavṛttitvaviśiṣṭatadabhāvavyakteḥ sattvena tadatyantābhāvasya bādhitatvāt|

evaṃ bhāvābhāvayoḥ parasparavirahātmakatvoktirapi matāntararītyā| svamate tu `atra ghaṭo nāsti' iti pratītyuttaraṃ yaddhaṭābhāvavaditi yathārthajñānaṃ tadviṣayībhūtaṃ yadviśiṣṭaṃ tadvyāpyatvaṃ ghaṭābhāvasya ghaṭaviraharūpatvam| evam `atra ghaṭābhāvo nāsti' ityādirītyā ghaṭasya ghaṭābhāvaviraharūpatvam|
analyzed: evam bhāva abhāvayoḥ paraspara viraha ātmaka tva uktiḥ api mata antara rītyā sva mate tu atra ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratīti uttaram yat dhaṭa abhāvavat iti yathārtha jñānam tad viṣayībhūtam yat viśiṣṭam tad vyāpya tvam ghaṭa abhāvasya ghaṭa viraha rūpa tvam evam atra ghaṭa abhāvaḥ na asti ityādi rītyā ghaṭasya ghaṭa abhāva viraha rūpa tvam

original: vyāpyatā ca nañullekhyasvapramottarapramāviṣayatayā bodhyā| ato na tasya kevalānvayitve'pi vyāpyatābhaṅgaḥ| evaṃkrameṇa tatpāribhāṣikameva| yadvā svapradhānakāropaviṣayapratiyogikatvamabhāvasya bhāvavirahātmakatvam| svaviṣayatāprayojyapratiyogitāsaṃsargāvacchinnaprakāratānirūpitapramīyaviṣayatāśrayatvaṃ paryavasitamabhāve|
analyzed: vyāpya tā ca nañ ullekhya sva pramā uttara pramā viṣayatayā bodhyā atas na tasya kevala anvayi tve pi vyāpya tā bhaṅgaḥ evaṃkrameṇa tat pāribhāṣikam eva yat vā sva pradhāna kāropa viṣaya pratiyogika tvam abhāvasya bhāva viraha ātmaka tvam sva viṣayatā prayojya pratiyogitā saṃsarga avacchinna prakāratā nirūpita pramīya viṣayatā āśraya tvam paryavasitam abhāve

original: bhāve tu tādṛśapratiyogiprakāratāprayojakaviṣayatā'śrayatvamiti rītyā pāribhāṣikam| prāgabhāvādisthale pratiyoginaḥ sattvādeva pratiyogiviṣayatā abhāvapramīyaprati yogiprakāratāprayojikā| atyantābhāvasthale tu satyabhūtapradhānaviṣayataiva kecidityuktamatarītyā prayojikā|
analyzed: bhāve tu tādṛśa pratiyogi prakāratā prayojaka viṣayatā āśraya tvam iti rītyā pāribhāṣikam prāgabhāva ādi sthale pratiyoginaḥ sattvāt eva pratiyogi viṣayatā abhāva pramīya prati yogi prakāratā prayojikā atyanta abhāva sthale tu satya bhūta pradhāna viṣayatā eva kecid iti ukta mata rītyā prayojikā

original: tatra ghaṭatvarūpasāmānyadharmāvacchinnaviṣayatā prayojikā cet sāmānyapradhānako'bhāvaḥ sāmānyābhāvapadavyavahāryaḥ| viśeṣadharmāvacchinnapradhānakastu viśeṣābhāvo bhavatīti tadvyavasthāpi ghabate| `śaśe viṣāṇaṃ nāsti' iti pratītisiddho'bhāvo viṣāṇapradhānakaḥ| `sarvatra śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāsti' iti pratītisiddho'bāvaḥ| śasaviṣāṇapradhānaka eva|
analyzed: tatra ghaṭa tva rūpa sāmānya dharma avacchinna viṣayatā prayojikā ced sāmānya pradhānakaḥ bhāvaḥ sāmānya abhāva pada vyavahāryaḥ viśeṣa dharma avacchinna pradhānakaḥ tu viśeṣa abhāvaḥ bhavati iti tad vyavasthā api ghabate śaśe viṣāṇam na asti iti pratīti siddhaḥ bhāvaḥ viṣāṇa pradhānakaḥ sarvatra śaśa viṣāṇam na asti iti pratīti siddhaḥ bhāvaḥ śasa viṣāṇa pradhānakaḥ eva

original: asato'pi tādṛśaviṣayatāśrayatvarūpaṃ prakṛtābhimatapradhānatvaṃ yuktam| bhāvābhāvayoruktavirahātmakatvaṃ bhāvābhāvabodhakavākyaprāmāṇyādau kathañcidupayujyata iti taduktirapi sārthakaiva| evamanyadapi ūhyamityalaṃ vistareṇa|
analyzed: asataḥ api tādṛśa viṣayatā āśraya tva rūpam prakṛta abhimata pradhānatvam yuktam bhāva abhāvayoḥ ukta viraha ātmaka tvam bhāva abhāva bodhaka vākya prāmāṇya ādau kathañcid upayujyate iti tad uktiḥ api sārthakā eva evam anyat api ūhyam iti alam vistareṇa

original: vaṃśapallīsthācāryāstu nirdoṣatvaṃ doṣāropapūrvakapratītiviṣayābhāvavattvamiti pariṣkṛtya pratiyogyārope yatpradhānaṃ tenāpi sākamasattiyogikābhāvasyāpi virodhamaṅgīkṛtya jīve'tivyāptiṃ parihṛtavantaḥ|
analyzed: vaṃśapallī stha ācāryāḥ tu nirdoṣatvam doṣa āropa pūrvaka pratīti viṣaya abhāvavat tvam iti pariṣkṛtya pratiyogi ārope yat pradhānam tena api sākam asatti yogika abhāvasya api virodham aṅgīkṛtya jīva itivyāptim parihṛtavantaḥ

original: teṣāṃ mate sarveṣāmatyantābhāvānāmasatpratiyogikatvāviśeṣe'pi `ghaṭavati bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti' `ghaṭābhāvavadidam' iti vākyāprāmāṇyādivyavasthābalāt satpradhānako'bhāvo vyatirekī pradhānabhūtasadvirodhī| asatpradhānakastu kevalānvayī| taraṅgiṇyuktasattvāsattvayoḥ parasparavirahātmakatvapariṣkāro'pyetanmatarītyā nirvāhyaḥ|
analyzed: teṣām mate sarveṣām atyanta abhāvānām asat pratiyogika tva aviśeṣe pi ghaṭavati bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti ghaṭa abhāva vat idam iti vākya aprāmāṇya ādi vyavasthā balāt sat pradhānakaḥ bhāvaḥ vyatirekī pradhāna bhūta sat virodhī asat pradhānakaḥ tu kevala anvayī taraṅgiṇī ukta sattva asattvayoḥ paraspara viraha ātmaka tva pariṣkāraḥ api etad mata rītyā nirvāhyaḥ

original: evamaprāmāṇikapratiyogikābhāvaniyame evamanye'pi kṣudropadravāḥ sūkṣmamatibhiḥ pariharaṇīyā ityalamiti vadanti|
analyzed: evam aprāmāṇika pratiyogika abhāva niyame evam anye api kṣudra upadravāḥ sūkṣma matibhiḥ pariharaṇīyāḥ iti alam iti vadanti

original: satyanāthaśrīcaraṇāḥ punarabhinavatāṇḍavādau prāmāṇikapratiyogikamapyatyantābhāvaṃ siddhānte vyavasthāpayantastanniyamaṃ tatyajuḥ| tanmate sarvā'pi vyavasthā sulabhaiva| vyavasthāpanaprakārastatkṛtagrantha evānusandheyaḥ| granthagauravabhayānneha prapañcyata iti|
analyzed: satyanātha śrī caraṇāḥ punar abhinava tāṇḍava ādau prāmāṇika pratiyogikam api atyanta abhāvam siddhānte vyavasthāpayantaḥ tad niyamam tatyajuḥ tad mate sarvā api vyavasthā sulabhā eva vyavasthāpana prakāraḥ tad kṛta granthe eva anusandheyaḥ grantha gaurava bhayāt na iha prapañcyate iti

original: tarhyanubhavakalaho'yaṃ niravadhiḥ iti cet yuktyā'pi bādhitatvāt| tathā hi, sādhyābhāvatvenāvagāhitvena kāraṇatvānaṅgīkāre vastuto yaḥ sādhyābhāvaḥ tadvyāpakābhāvapratiyogitvajñānasya kāraṇatvaṃ vācyam| tathātve rūpābhāvābhāvātmakatayā tadrūpasya tadrūpavyāpakābhāvapratiyogighaṭatvavattvājñānāt ghaṭe rūpābhāvānumitiḥ syāt|
analyzed: tarhi anubhava kalahaḥ iyam niravadhiḥ iti ced yuktyā api bādhita tvāt tathā hi sādhya abhāva tvena avagāhi tvena kāraṇatva anaṅgīkāre vastutas yaḥ sādhya abhāvaḥ tad vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tva jñānasya kāraṇa tvam vācyam tathātve rūpa abhāva abhāva ātmaka tayā tad rūpasya tad rūpa vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi ghaṭa tva vat tva ajñānāt ghaṭe rūpa abhāva anumitiḥ syāt

original: evaṃ bhāvasādhyakasthale'pi vahnyabhāvasya tadvyaktitvenāvagāhinaḥ tadvyaktivyāpakābhāvapratiyogidhūmavattājñānāt parvate vahnirityanupasthitasādhyamukhyaviśeṣyakānumityāpattiśca| abhāvasādhyakasthale'numitiṃ svīkṛtya bhāvasādhyakasthale tadanaṅgīkāre tu ardhajaratīyanyāyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: evam bhāva sādhyaka sthale api vahni abhāvasya tad vyakti tvena avagāhinaḥ tad vyakti vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi dhūmavat tā jñānāt parvate vahniḥ iti anupasthita sādhya mukhya viśeṣyaka anumiti āpattiḥ ca abhāva sādhyaka sthale numitim svīkṛtya bhāva sādhyaka sthale tad anaṅgīkāre tu ardhajaratīya nyāya āpatteḥ

original: na ca bhāvapratiyogikābhāvaniṣṭhatadvyaktitvaṃ pratiyogiviśeṣapratiyogikatvātiriktaṃ durvacamiti vācyam| rūpādāviva pratiyogyaghaṭitasyaiva tadvyaktitvasya tatra sattvāt| anyathā pralaye sarvavahnināśe abhāvaniṣṭhatadvyaktitvasyāpi nāśaprasaṅgena tadvyaktirūpatvābhāvenetaratādātmyaṃ niḥsvarūpatvaṃ vā syāt|
analyzed: na ca bhāva pratiyogika abhāva niṣṭha tad vyakti tvam pratiyogi viśeṣa pratiyogika tva atiriktam durvacam iti vācyam rūpa ādau iva pratiyogya ghaṭitasya eva tad vyakti tvasya tatra sattvāt anyathā pralaye sarva vahni nāśe abhāva niṣṭha tad vyakti tvasya api nāśa prasaṅgena tad vyakti rūpatva abhāvena itara tādātmyam niḥsvarūpa tvam vā syāt

original: caitreṇa `hnade yatkiñcidvartate' ityuktau tatkālīnacaitroccāritayatkiñcitpadātparyaviṣayatayā vahnyabhāvāvagāhinaḥ `tādṛśayatkiñcitpadatātparyaviṣayībhūtavyāpakābhāvapratiyogi' ityādiparāmarśāduktānumityāpatterdurvāratvācca| evamabhidheyatvābhāvanirūpitavyatirekiparāmarśādbhramātmakābhidheyatvābhāvānumitirvyatirekyābhāsājjāyate| sā na syāt|
analyzed: caitreṇa hnade yat kiñcid vartate iti uktau tad kālīna caitra uccārita yat kiñcit padātparya viṣayatayā vahni abhāva avagāhinaḥ tādṛśa yat kiñcit pada tātparya viṣayībhūta vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi ityādi parāmarśāt ukta anumiti āpatteḥ durvāra tvāt ca evam abhidheya tva abhāva nirūpita vyatireki parāmarśāt bhrama ātmaka abhidheya tva abhāva anumitiḥ vyatireki ābhāsāt jāyate sā na syāt

original: tatra sādhyasyaivāprasiddhyā tadabhāvasya vāstavasyābhāvena tatra kāraṇatāvacchedakavirahāt|
analyzed: tatra sādhyasya eva aprasiddhyā tad abhāvasya vāstavasya abhāvena tatra kāraṇatā avacchedaka virahāt

original: na ca vāstavasādhyābhāvaghaṭitakāraṇāntarāṅgīkāre'pi pratiyaṣedhākāraparāmarśasya kāraṇatāyā aparityāgāt nirūpyanirūpakabhāvāpannaviṣayitāśālibhramātmakaparāmarśādeva vyatirekyābhāsaliṅgākānumityupapattiriti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca vāstava sādhya abhāva ghaṭita kāraṇa antara aṅgīkāre api pratiyaṣedha ākāra parāmarśasya kāraṇatāyāḥ aparityāgāt nirūpya nirūpaka bhāva āpanna viṣayitā śāli bhrama ātmaka parāmarśāt eva vyatireki ābhāsa liṅgāka anumiti upapattiḥ iti vācyam

original: uktakāraṇāntarāṅgīkarturbhavato mate `dhūmavyāpakābhāvapratiyogivahnyabhāvavān hnadaḥ' iti jñānāddhrade dhūmābhāvānumiteriva `abhidheyatvavyāpakābhāvapratiyogighaṭatvābhāvavān paṭaḥ' iti bharamāt `paṭe'bhigheyatvābhāvaḥ' ityanumiterduṣpariharatayā tatsthalīyaparāmarśe bhavaduktakāraṇāvacchedakābhāvādvyatirekyābhāsatvānupapatterityabhiprāyāt|
analyzed: ukta kāraṇa antara aṅgīkartuḥ bhavataḥ mate dhūma vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi vahni abhāvavān hnadaḥ iti jñānāt hrade dhūma abhāva anumiteḥ iva abhidheya tva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi ghaṭa tva abhāvavān paṭaḥ iti bharamāt iti anumiteḥ duṣparihara tayā tad sthalīya parāmarśe bhavat ukta kāraṇa avacchedaka abhāvāt vyatireki ābhāsa tva anupapatteḥ iti abhiprāyāt

original: etena `sādhyībhūtābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchinnanirūpitavyāpakatvāvagāhijñānasya kāraṇatvam' iti pratyuktam| uktasthale sādhyībhūtābhāvasyaivāprasiddheḥ|
analyzed: etena sādhyībhūta abhāva pratiyogitā avacchedaka avacchinna nirūpita vyāpaka tva avagāhi jñānasya kāraṇa tvam iti pratyuktam ukta sthale sādhyībhūta abhāvasya eva aprasiddheḥ

original: na ca taddharmāvacchinnaviṣayatānirūpitābhāvatvāvacchinnavidheyatākānumitau taddharmāvacchinnanirūpitavyāpakatāvacchedakatvena gṛhītadharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvanirṇayatvena parāmarśasya tādṛśajñānadvayasādhāraṇyenāpi hetutā svīkriyate| ata eva vyatirekigranthe dīdhitikṛtā tathaivoktam| itthañca na ko'pi pūrvoktadoṣaḥ prasaratīti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca tad dharma avacchinna viṣayatā nirūpita abhāva tva avacchinna vidheya tāka anumitau tad dharma avacchinna nirūpita vyāpaka tā avacchedaka tvena gṛhīta dharma avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāva nirṇaya tvena parāmarśasya tādṛśa jñāna dvaya sādhāraṇyena api hetutā svīkriyate atas eva vyatireki granthe dīdhiti kṛtā tathā eva uktam ittham ca na kaḥ api pūrva ukta doṣaḥ prasarati iti vācyam

original: `hnado dhūmābhāvavān dhūmatvāvacchinnavyāpakatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnābhāvavattvāt| yo yaddharmāvacchinnavyāpakatāvacchedakadharmāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvavān sa taddharmāvacchinnābhāvavān' iti sāmānyavyāptijñānena vā yattvatattvānanugamavidveṣe tu `yo yadviśeṣābhāvakūṭavān sa tatsāmānyābhāvavān' `yo yaddhetuḥ sa tadvyāptaḥ' `yadyanmaṅgalaṃ
analyzed: hnadaḥ dhūma abhāvavān dhūma tva avacchinna vyāpakatā avacchedaka dharma avacchinna abhāvavat tvāt yaḥ yad dharma avacchinna vyāpakatā avacchedaka dharma avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāvavān sa tad dharma avacchinna abhāvavān iti sāmānya vyāpti jñānena vā yattva tattva ananugama vidveṣe tu yaḥ yad viśeṣa abhāva kūṭavān sa tad sāmānya abhāvavān yaḥ yad hetuḥ sa tad vyāptaḥ yat yat maṅgalam

original: tattasamāptisādhanam' `yo yasya sutaḥ sa tadīyaṃ dhanamādadīta' ityādau yattvatattvahetutvasādhyatvamaṅgalatvasamāptitvāderanugatatvābhāve'pi tatrānubhavasiddhānumitinirvāhāya sāmānyavyāptisthānābhiṣiktavyāptyantarāvagāhijñānenānumitisvīkāreṇa prakṛte'pi tathaivānumitisvīkārasambhavenokta vidhavyatirekiparāmarśasya phalopadhāyakatvānaṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: yaḥ yasya sutaḥ sa tadīyam dhanam ādadīta ityādau yattva tattva hetutva sādhyatva maṅgalatva samāpti tva ādeḥ anugata tva abhāve pi tatra anubhava siddha anumiti nirvāhāya sāmānya vyāpti sthāna abhiṣikta vyāpti antara avagāhi jñānena anumiti svīkāreṇa prakṛte api tathā eva anumiti svīkāra sambhavena ukta vidha vyatireki parāmarśasya phala upadhāyakatva anaṅgīkārāt

original: na ca vahnitvāvacchinnābhāvaliṅgakatvaṃ na syāt| api tu dhūmavyāpakatāvacchedakavahnitvāvacchinnābhāvaliṅgakatvameva syāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| tadrūpāvacchinnāsphūrtidaśāyāmeva vahnitvāvacchinnābhāvaliṅgakānumityudayāt|
analyzed: na ca vahni tva avacchinna abhāva liṅgaka tvam na syāt api tu dhūma vyāpakatā avacchedaka vahni tva avacchinna abhāva liṅgaka tvam eva syāt na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ tad rūpa avacchinna asphūrti daśāyām eva vahni tva avacchinna abhāva liṅgaka anumiti udayāt

original: tadarthameva coktavyatirekavyāpteraṅgatvamapi svīkriyata iti vācyam `dhūmavyāpakavahnyabhāvavān' iti parāmarśasya bhavadabhimatasyaiva matsiddhaliṅgasphūrtirūpatayā tadasphūrterevāsiddheḥ| parantu tvayā taduttarakṣaṇa eva `hnade dhūmābhāvaḥ' ityākārāmanubhavaviruddhāmanumitiṃ svīkṛtya tato `dhūmābhāvavān' ityanumityantaraṃ svīkriyate|
analyzed: tad artham eva ca ukta vyatireka vyāpteḥ aṅgatvam api svīkriyate iti vācyam dhūma vyāpaka vahni abhāvavān iti parāmarśasya bhavat abhimatasya eva mad siddha liṅga sphūrti rūpatayā tad asphūrteḥ eva asiddheḥ parantu tvayā tad uttara kṣaṇe eva hnade dhūma abhāvaḥ iti ākārām anubhava viruddhām anumitim svīkṛtya tatas dhūma abhāvavān iti anumiti antaram svīkriyate
